tei:div.tei:p: "$ (243)༄༅// rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i khyad chos ri chos yon tan kun 'byung gi snying po ma drug gi gdams zab bzhugs so//

(244)༄༅// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug /phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu de la dad pa'i yid kyis gus pa'i lus btud snyan pa'i ngag brjod de/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// khyed kyi gsung ngag bdud rtsi'i thig pa 'di phyogs thams cad du nyi zla ltar rgyas par gyur cig /ri chos yon tan kun 'byung nas gdams ngag gnad kyi snying po drug ces bya ba ston pa zhal gdams brjod pas 'jigs nas yi ger 'god pas gnang bar zhu'o// de la ma drug ni/ drag rlung gnad lnga ma/ 'pho ba hūm̐ dmar ma/ stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ma/ gsang spyod rmang lam ma/ nad 'don hūm̐ chos ma/ 'dzag srung bka' rgya ma'o// dang po drag rlung gnad lnga ma la/ spyir rdo rje'i theg pa thabs kyis khyad par du byas pa yin/ thabs de yang rdo rje'i lus la rlung sems kyi rten 'brel gnas du bsnun bas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang dbang med par mngon du byed pa ste/ dper na lus kyis chang 'thungs na sems ra ro nas 'gro ba dang 'dra ba yin/ de la gnas pa rtsa g.yo ba rlung bkod pa byang chub kyi sems gsum gyi nang na yang (245)rlung mchog tu gyur ba ste/ rtsa khyim dang 'dra/ thig le nor dang 'dra/ rlung bdag po dang 'dra ba yin/ de yang dgongs pa lung ston gyi rgyud las/ rlung zhes bya bas las kun byed// rnam shes bzhon pa'i rta pho ste// lnga yi bdag nyid bcu ming can// rten 'brel bcu gnyis zhes grags pa// ngo bo rnam pa gsum du 'gyur// rlung zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems/ rnam shes kun gyi gtso 'di yin// ces gsungs pas/ rlung 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid mir gi dbye ba bcu/ dus sbyor gyi khyim bcu gnyis su 'pho ba/ ngo bo 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rang bzhin can/ phyi nang med par 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rlung rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin yin no// zhes bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag gi lugs su byed pa la/

lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag nas/ rlung pa 'jug pa bzhi/ dbye ba bcu/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad bdun// man ngag gi gnad bdun cu tham pa zhes gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang rlung la 'jam rlung drag rlung gnyis/ dang po la dgang ba dbyung ba med pa dang*/ dgang (246)ba dbyung ba dang bcas pa gnyis/ drag rlung bum pa can dang*/ bum can ma yin pa gnyis su gsungs yod/ de las gzhan pa'i rlung sbyor la/ dgram pa/ btang ba/ bzung ba/ dgang ba dang*/ kha sbyor/ rlung rgya yan/ pho rlung gdul ba/ mo rlung sbyor ba ma ning gi rlung btsan thabs su dgag pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs pas/ 'dir de rnams kyi gnas dril ba rlung gi myong bas grub pa ste/ gtso cher 'phags pa yab sras dang bir wa pa'i rjes su 'brangs pa/ rlung drag po rdo rje thod sbyor nyams su blang ba'i gnad lnga dang bcas pa ston te/ de la rdo rje thod sbyor ces pa ni/ rdo rje rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa/ thod pa ni ka pā la ste bde ba skyong ba/ sbyor ba bde stong myur du bskyed pa'am sbyor bar byed pa ste/ rdo rje theg pa'i rlung sbyor thun mong ma yin pa zhes pa'i sgra don no// de yang rlung sgom pa phal cher mu stegs kyi rlung sbyor yod/ nyan thos/ sems tsam dbu ma'i rlung sbyor la sogs pa yod de/ rdo rje theg pa'i rlung sbyor gsang dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa phyin ci ma logs pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa sgom shes pa nyung bar 'dug /gong ma rnams kyis sems zin pa'am/ thun mong gi drod rtags sna re tsam 'byung gi /rlung bcu gcig tu mi zin pas rtsa mdud mi 'jig cing*/ ye shes skye bar mi nus so// des na rlung bcu gcig tu mi zin/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum lam du mi slong ba'i rlung sbyor zab kyang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i rlung sbyor ma yin no// de la rlung rdo rje thod sbyor la khyad par gyi byed chos gsum/

lus gnad kyi khyad par rtsa steng 'og kha sbyor gyi gnad kyis yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir 'thems pa/ rlung sbyor gyi khyad par rlung phyi nang dbyer med kyi gnad kyis rlung bcu gnyis tu zin pa/ dmigs pa'i khyad par dngos po'i gnas lugs dang mthun pas rlung sems gcig tu 'dril ba'o// dang po ni 'khrul 'khor me thab kyi drug chings yin te/ dang po rkang pa (247)re mig ltar bsnol ba la/ g.yas pa phyir btang g.yon pa nang du bcug pa'i rting pas bshang gci'i bar bltems pas/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i sindhu ra/ su warna ṭī pa/ sau raṣṭa/ pre ta bu ri/ gṛ ha de ba/ hi mā la ya/ de rnams dbang du sdud pa ste/ yul de rnams kyi rlung 'gag /rtsa steng 'og kha sbyor du 'gro'o// gnyis pa lag pa zhags pa ltar bsdams pa ni mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya lte 'og sor gnyis su btsir ti gru mo thur la brgyangs pas/ yul nyer bzhi'i/ nā ga ra/ ma ru/ tri sha ku ni/ kā ma rū pa/ de rnams dbang du sdud pa gong bzhin no// gsum pa mgrin pa lcag kyu ltar dgug pa ni/ mgrin pa drang la sgu bar bya ste/ rgyab tu rti par go 'thems pas rtsa chu'i kha 'thims nas bde ba skye/ byang sems 'beb pa'i rtsa g.yon pa 'thems pas thig le mi 'dzag /mdun du ol mdud sbas pas snying kha'i rtsa ba sinta kha gyen la blta/ mig mi 'dzum par hrig ger blta/ lce cung zad bzlog ste rkan la sbyar/ lus gnad des yul nyer bzhi'i spyi gtsug dzā lendha ra/ a ra bu ta/ au ḍī ya na/ go dā ba ri/ de bī ko ṭi/ ka liṅka/ lamba ka /de rnams dbang du byed pa gong bzhin no// bzhi pa dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs pas yul nyer bzhi'i/ kañtsi ka /o ṭi/ mā la ba/ de rnams dbang du sdud pa'o// lnga pa lus sems li ri ltar bsgrims pas yul de rnams 'chun cing dbang du sdud pas bde drod myur du skye'o// drug pa rked pa mda' ltar bsrang bas yul de thams cad du yon tan bskyed/

lus kyi rtsa bran thams cad nang du kha blta/ dbu ma shin tu dwangs par 'gyur te/ rlung rang gnas su 'jug pa'o// de ltar 'khrul 'khor me thab kyi drug chings des/ yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa gcig dngos su 'chun cing*/ ko sa la/ sulli ra ma/ rā me shwa ri gsum yang shugs kyis 'chun pas/ yul de (248)rnams su rlung 'gags pas mi rtog pa skye/ rtsa steng 'og kha sbyor du 'gro/ khams dang snyigs ma phyed pas bde ba skye/ rtsa kha bye bas drod skye/ rtsa mdud 'jig pas 'jig rten pa'i lam gyi ye shes dang yon tan dpag tu med pa skye ba'i rten te/ 'khrul 'khor 'di bcas pa tsam gyis bde drod 'ur gyis 'ong ba yin/ rlung bcu dbang du 'dus te rkang pa re mig ltar bsnol bas thur sel dbang du sdud/ lag pa zhags pa ltar bsdams pas mnyam gnas/ mgrin pa lcag kyu ltar bkug pas gyen rgyu/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar gdengs pas srog 'dzin/ rked pa mda' ltar bsrang ba dang*/ lus li ri ltar bsgrim pas las khyab byed dbang du sdud/ de ltar rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dbang du 'dus pas/ yan lag gi rlung lnga dbang du 'du ba ste/ mdor na pha rgyud nas rlung gtsor ston/ ma rgyud nas rtsa gtsor ston pa ste/ de rnams 'khrul 'khor lus gnad 'thims pa gcig gis dbang du byed pa lags/ gzhan kun la 'khrul 'khor 'di 'ol tshod tsam yod de/ ming rkyang tsam las/ 'di la gnang 'di yod med pas khyad par gyi chos so// gnyis pa rlung sbyor gyi khyad par la/ rlung phyi nang dbyer med ces pa'i gnad 'di sus kyang go ba med/ thabs lam pa thams cad rlung cung zad nang du gnas na yon tan skye/ de kas las zin pa tshod/ phyi ru song na yon tan phyang pa tshod du byas nas rtsol ba che la yon tan chung bzhi ga byed par 'dug ste/ 'di thams cad rlung sems dbyer med rlung phyi nang dbyer med ma go ba yin/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rlung rnam par shes pa'i rang gzugs yin/

de la phyi nang dbyer med de/ nam mkha' khyab tshad rlung sems kyis khyab ste/ de'i ngo bo yong ba min/ de la lus sems bem rig rnam rtog tha dad phyi nang 'dzin pa thams cad 'khrul ba'i snang ngo yin no// don la tha dad med/ dbu mar tshud pa ces pa yang phyi nang med par rlung (249)sems nam mkha'i ngo bor dwangs te 'gyu ba dang bral ba gcig yin gyi/ rlung thams cad rtsa gcig gi nang du bstums nas sdod pa ni ma yin no// don gyi dbu ma yang de yin no// des phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel gyis rtsa dbu mar tshud pa'i dus su/ phyi nang med par rlung sems nam mkha'i ngo bor dwangs te/ 'byung 'jug gi rlung dang gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa rgyun chad pa'o// des dbu mar rlung 'jug /des nang du zin pa dang 'jug pas/ rlung phyi ru zin dang nang du zin pa la yon tan khyad med/ bar du rlung 'gyu ba la zin kyang khyad med/ thabs kyis zin na de thams cad yon tan mnyam por skye/ sems phyi ru zin pa dang nang du zin pa dang 'gyu ba'i thog tu zin pa rnams khyad med de mi rtog pa mnyam por skye ba yin/ de thams cad rlung sems phyi nang dbyer med pa yin pa'i phyir ro// des na dpal chen bir wa pas/ 'byung ba lam du byed pa la gtong ba'i yan lag gsum/ 'jug pa lam du byed pa la dgang ba'i yan lag gnyis/ gnas pa lam du byed pa la kha sbyor/ de thams cad sdom pa la srog rtsol gyi man ngag gsungs/ dus 'khor nas kyang*/ rlung sbyor drug gsungs so// de thams cad yon tan mnyam por skye bar bshad pa yin/ de ltar phyi nang dbyer med kyi gnad kyis/ rlung bcud dbang du sdus pa la/ rlung la phra ba'i rlung dang rags pa'i rlung gnyis/ phra ba'i rlung sems kyis khyab tshad du gsal gnas zer ba yin la/ zhes pa'i rlung la rtsa ba'i rlung lnga yan lag gi rlung lnga ste bcu/ bug dgu'i rlung lus kyi cha shas khyab par rgyu ste/

de thams cad gcig tu zin dgos/ de ma zin na 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa mdud 'jig mi nus/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa mdud 'jig mi nus/ rlung 'gag mi nus te ye shes mi skye'o// da lta rlung sgoms pa phal cher gyen rgyu phyir mi rgyu ba dang*/ 'og sgo las mi byed pa tsam la rlung sgom pa byed de don mi 'grub/ (250)de'ang rlung de rnams dbang du sdud pa la gnad lnga ste/ rlung ldog pa mi 'byung ba 'bud pa'i gnad/ rlung dang gnas su bzung ba rngub pa'i gnad/ rlung dbang du bsdu ba dgang ba'i gnad/ rlung rtsa mig tu gdab pa gzhil ba'i gnad/ rlung phyi nang bsre ba gtong ba'i gnad do// rlung sbyor de rnams rgyud las bshad de/ gdan bzhi las/ rngub dang dgang pa gzhil ba dang*/ mda' ltar 'phang dang rnam pa bzhi/ rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan ma shes na/ yon tan skyon du 'gyur ba yin/ ces pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las lta stang bzhi dang phrin las bzhi yang 'grub par bshad la/ thig le dbang du sdud pa la/ rngub pas bzung ba dgang bas skyil ba/ gtong bas 'dren pa/ gzhil bas dgram pa 'grub pa ste/ mdor na rlung sbyor 'dir rtsa rlung thig le'i yon tan mtha' dag skye ba'o// de la dang po 'bud pa ni/ drag por gsum 'bud/ 'jam la ring ba gsum 'bud/ lus gcu zhing gsum 'bud pa ste/ da la rtsa sbubs na rlung ro ngan pa yod pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ snod bkru bshal byas par zas lhugs pa lta bu ste/ rlung ro ma bus par rlung bkag na/ dper na 'o ma rul pa thags gcig gis/ 'o ma zangs gang ba 'drul ba ltar/ rtsa sbubs kyi rlung ro ngan pa des rlung bkag pa de thams cad dbang du byas nas gegs skyon du 'gyur la/ de sbyangs pas rlung gi nad thams cad mi 'byung*/ gzhan yang dbang po thams cad dwangs/ 'du ba'i nad thams cad sel/ lus yang zhing mgyogs/ lus bkrag mdangs rgyas/ gegs sngar yod pa thams cad sel ba ste/ rje ko brag pa'i gegs sel gyi gnad thams cad gcig 'dril ba'i rlung sbyor yin pas/

'dud ba dgu'i gnad ma 'chugs pa gal che'o// gnyis pa rngubs ba ni/ mgrin pa cung zad gubs drag la sga med du ring ba rngub la/ rlung gi shugs rdzogs pa dang mchil ma thig gcig dang sbrags la/ mnyam (251)bzhag cer gyis bsgrim ste/ lus drang por ldigs kyis bskyur la lte 'og tu hril gyis gtong ba'o// dper na sbud pa rlung gis gang yang*/ se khar ma 'dril na me mi pher/ de bzhin du lus rlung gis gang yang lte 'og gi gnas su ma 'dril na bde drod mi skye/ gsum pa dgang ba ni/ de nas mar tsir mi mnon par ro stod seng byas la/ so bar bag tsam bzhag /rlung rang sa ru seng nge khegs pa la khrim me bsgrims nas/ lte 'og tu hril gtod pa yin/ ma bsgrims na chu rlung stobs 'phel 'gro/ 'og rlung yang lus dang po chus chus pa gsum byas te srin po'i zhal thems btang nas drag tu 'then 'then/ rlung zhabs sol 'jog dbugs byung na mi bskyil/ 'og rlung dang po nas sdom na bla ma dang gdams ngag gnad can med na rlung log mang ba yin/ rgyu mtshan rlung tsha grang gnyis rta g.yag gi tshul du yod pas/ de gnyis ma snyams pa las gegs skyon 'byung la/ steng rlung cung zad 'byongs nas rlung bsdoms pas/ steng rlung bde gsal gyi rang bzhin drod du skyes pa dang*/ drod gnyis snyams nas gegs mi long pa yin no// rlung steng 'og gnyis po thub pa dang drag tu gcun/ de thub mi thub gcig 'dzin pa yin/ des rlung bcu gcig tu zin dgos te/ khyab byed ched du zin pas rtsa rnams kyi 'phar bstongs 'gro/ thur sel gyen la log cing me rlung stobs 'phel bas bde drod skye/ srog 'dzin dwangs snyigs phyed pas rnam rtog gi 'gyu ba chad/ gyen rgyu gnad ru tsud pas rlung tsha grang 'dres zhing dgang ba la dbang thob/ de'i stobs kyis yan lag gi rlung lnga yang zin te/ dbang po rnams las bshog nas yul la mi 'dzin par/

sgom lnga rtog med du had kyis 'gro/ de ltar rlung bcu gcig tu zil pa'i rlung sbyor rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa/ rlung phra rags thams cad phyi nang gnyis med kyi gnad kyis nang du dbang du (252)sdud pa ste/ mthar phyin pa'i tshe ji tsam bkag kyang mi bde ba med pa 'byung ngo*// bzhi pa gzhil ba ni/ de mi thub pa dang*/ rlung gi dug dbyung ba bya ba cung zad tsam btang*/ yang rngubs la mnan/ de ni dper na ja bskol ba'i gzhur nas spu bar g.yeng ba de phyir pho ba dang 'dra ste gnad che ba yin no// de mi thub pa dang g.yas su gcig bcag /g.yon du gcig bcag /dbus su gcig bcag /yang seng ge rtsal spugs kyis 'phar zhing bcag go /des ni rtsa rnams kyi mdud pa grol zhing yon tan gyi rtsa kha bye nas dbu mar rlung myur du 'jug pa'i rlung sbyor ro// 'phar ba des rlung thams cad rang sar phebs te rlung mthos pa'i log pa thams cad mi 'byung ngo*// lnga pa btang ba ni/ cung zad nang du 'then la drag tu shad kyis lhag ma med par btang*/ phyi ru gnas tshad cig bzhag /btang ba'i dus su lta ba gul tsam nang du 'then la/ dmigs pa lte 'og tu gtad pa gal che/ dwangs ma'i rlung zhabs 'dzin pa gal che/ de ni rlung phrag rags thams cad phyi nang dbyer med kyis nad kyis phyi ru dbang du sdud pa ste/ ji tsam btang yang mi bde ba med tsa na mthar phyin pa'o// rlung phyi nang rang 'dres su tsha ba yin no// de ltar yang yang ngal mi gso ba ru rngubs nas/ g.yas su rlung sbyor de rnams chang ba gcig /g.yon du de rnams tshang ba gcig /dbus su rlung sbyor de rnams tshang ba gcig ste/ dus re las ngal mi gso bar bzhi skor re byed pa yin/ de rnams la gnad ma 'khrul pa gal che ste/ de yang btang ba'i gnad gzhil ba la rags/ gzhil ba'i gnad dgang ba la rags/ dgang ba'i gnad rngubs pa la rags/ rngubs pa'i gnad 'bud pa la rags te/

gcig 'khrul na thams cad 'khrul 'gro/ de yang rlung lhag stod du lus na 'bud pa'i gnad 'khrul rlung bcu gcig tu mi zin na dgang ba'i (253)gnad 'khrul/ srog rtsol gyi rlung dhū ti'i mar snar mi 'dril na rngubs pa'i gnad 'khrul/ khangs pa lus la mi khrims na gzhil ba'i gnad 'khrul/ dbyung ba mthun du mi bslongs na btang ba'i gnad 'khrul lo// de ltar rngubs pas 'jug pa lam du byed/ dgong ba dang gzhil bas gnas pa lam du byed/ btang bas dbyung ba lam du byed pa ste/ rang bzhin gyis 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rlung sbyor gcig gis dbang du byed cing*/ rlung sems phyi nang dbyer med kyi gnad kyis/ rlung bcu gcig tu zin pa'i rlung sbyor 'di rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung gsang dbang gi mngon par rtogs pa thun mong ma yin pa yin no// gzhan gyi rlung sbyor dang 'di sha rgyab tu yod/ gzhan gyi rlung gegs mang ba'i rgyu mtshan gnang mang du 'chugs yod pa yin/ thog mar 'bud pa mi shes des gegs mang*/ rngubs pa la sgra dang bcas pas grang zhing sbo// drag pas rtsa gnas gzhan du 'byer/ kha nas rngubs pas snying rlung 'ong*/ srog rtsol gang rung nas rngubs pas tshe thung*/ sna sgo nas zin tsam rngubs pas shugs mi rdzogs/ dgang ba dbang du mi 'du/ 'khrul 'khor smad du bskyur ma shes pas stod mi bde/ bde drod bul/ dgang ba la rlung bcu gcig tu ma zin pas/ yul nye bzhi'i rlung 'gag mi nus pas ye shes mi skye/ rlung tsha grang ma 'dres pas yon tan gang yang mi skye/ gzhil bal la ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas rlung song bar bsgom zer te/ de la skya rbab bam/ yang dag par rgyu'i rlung log dogs yod/ yon tan gyi rtsa kham bye bar rlung dbu mar mi tshud/ btang ba la spyi bo nas rtsal po ches mda' 'phangs pa bzhin sngo phyu ru song bar bsam zer te/ de shin tu gnad 'khrul tshe la nan tan gnod/ rlung log 'ong*/

rlung zhabs 'jog ste des mi 'grub/ rlung phyin pa bsre ba ma (254)shes par dka' las che la don chung ba'i rlung sgom pa mang bar 'dug /'di de rnams dang sha rgyab tu yod de/ gegs mi 'byung la yon tan myur du skye ba'i gnad shin tu mang bar yod/ thabs lam pa rnams phyag len mtha' chod par legs par lag khrid tshar ba gal che'o// gsum pa dmigs pa'i khyad par dngos po'i gnas lugs dang mthun pa ni/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs dang mthun/ phyi nang gsang gsum rten 'brel/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ brda' don 'phrod pa zhig dgos te/ de gnad 'chugs na bskal par bsgoms kyang yon tan mi skye ste/ rna ba la mig snyam du bsgom pa dang 'dra/ mig tu bskal par bsgoms kyang rna ba mig tu mi 'gro ba bzhin no// rje ras pa chen po'i zhal nas rgyu las ma byung ba'i 'bras bu dka'/ rlan las ma byung ba'i me tog dka'/ gnad du ma song ba'i sems 'dzin dka'i/ gsungs so// sgom pa don gyi gnad rlung 'byung ba lnga'i rten/ khams bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma/ nyon mongs pa dug lnga'am/ ye shes lnga'i rang gzugs 'khor lo lnga'i gnad kyi snying po ma 'khrul ba dngos po'i gnas lugs dang mthun pa gal che ste/ lte bar gtum mo lam du byed pas mnyam gnas me'i rten/ bde chen me shel rgod ma kha'i gnad/ phag mo'i thig le a shad kyi gzugs/ de'i gnad ma 'khrul pa gal che ba yin/ lte ba'i dbus na a'i gzugs kyis gnas pa dang*/ dus skabs 'ga' zhig gi tshe a shad tsheg drag tu 'gro ba/ de la sogs pa rgyun gyi gnas lugs ma yin te/ nor sa yod/ 'od gsal lam du byed pa la snying kha chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na yon tan gyi rtsa ba santa zhes bya ba'i dbus na/ thig le hūm̐ gi gzugs yungs kar sbom po tsam gcig yod pa yin/ de lus can rnams kyi shes pa gsal stong mi rtog pa skye ba'i rgyu'am rten byed pa yin/

'od gsal 'dzin pa'i gnad kyang de (255)yin/ a nu ta ra hūm̐ yang der bsgom pa yin/ snying kha'i phyi 'dab dang zhe sdang gi hūm̐ la sogs par bsgom na gnad 'chugs 'gro ste nor sa yod/ sgyu lus lam du byed pa la mgrin pa a'i rtsa mdud a'i gzugs la dmigs pa yin/ thig le a'i gzugs la dmigs pa yin te nor sa yod/ las kyi phyag rgya lam du byed pas spyi gtsug gi thig le zla ba nya ba dang*/ haṃ rkyang pa dang*/ haṃ bcu drug pa dang*/ mdzod spu'i haṃ kyog po dang*/ lce chung gi haṃ dang*/ de rnams la sgom pa dus kyi gnad ma 'khrul ba dgos te nor sa yod/ de ltar dmigs pa'i gnad dngos po'i gnas lugs dang mthun pas dmigs pa de la sems rtse gcig tu bzung bas/ rlung sems dbyer med pa'i gnas kyis rlung dang*/ mchog gi gnas der rlung chud pa ste/ dmigs pa rlung 'dzin pa'i gnad de go bar byas la dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu gcun cing*/ gegs mang ba rnams dmigs pa mi gsal ba dang*/ sems yengs pa las byung bar shes par bya'o// de ltar rlung sems dbyer med/ lus sems dbyer med/ snang sems dbyer med kyi gnad kyis/ rlung 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa gsum tshogs pa gcig tu byas pa'i gnad 'dis myur du lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du byed par yin gyis/ de las gzhan pa rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi snying po ma shes pa'i/ mgo bor 'di bsgom dang 'phongs su 'di bsgom gyi dmigs pa'i rnam bzhag mang po dang*/ yul che ge mor bla ma rje btsun che ge mo'i gdams ngag 'di dang zhes ba'i tshig snyan snyan 'dra ba'i rdzun gyi phreng ba brgyus pa'i thag rul gyi snal 'breng hrul mthud pa de rnams kyis yul mtha' 'khob tu rmong pa'i mgo bo bskor ba la phan gyi/ byang chub sgrub pa'i sgom chen pa nyams su len pa la mi phan pas/ grub thob brgyud pa'i gdams ngag (256)gnad ma 'chug gol sa med pa'i phul/

shul breng nge ba 'di rnams shes bzo dang tshod yod mi bya bar/ legs par thugs su chud par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// drag rlung gnang lnga ma'i zhal gdams che long tsam yi ger bkod pa'o// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ba/ 'pho ba hūm̐ dmar ma'i lo rgyus ni/ rje mar pa lo tsā ba la/ dge bshes rngog chos rdor gyis 'bri dkar zal ma gcig bu brgya tham pa/ sbra dang shel ma sgo khyi tshun chod phul/ g.yang nyams 'gro byas nas 'bri phud gcig bzhag /de min thams cad phul ba'i dus su/ spyir du yang gdams ngag mang du gnang*/ khyad par du 'pho ba'i gdams ngag 'di gnang nas bsgoms pas/ spyi bo tsha nas mi zug pa byung nas/ gdams ngag 'dra mi bdog gam zhu byas pas/ nga'i gdams ngag gi g.yang nyams nas 'ong gsung*/ der 'bri phud bzhag pa dang*/ de min yang nor mang du phul nas zhus pas/ log gnon dang tshe sring ba'i dmigs pa gnyis gnang ba yin gsung*/ 'pho ba khyad par gyur pa rngog la gnang ba bya ba yin/ gtum mo khyad par du gyur pa mi la la gnang ba bya ba yin/ bka' brgyud 'pho ba'i gdams ngag tsam na 'di las zab pa med pa bya ba yin no// de nyams su len pa la gnyis/ sbyong ba dang las la sbyar ba'o// sbyong ba la gnyis/ thog mar sngon 'gro rlung bum pa can sbyong ba/ 'pho ba dngos sbyong ba'o// dang po ni/ 'khrul 'khor skyil krung lag pa mnyam bzhag tu byas la/ thog mar rlung drag tu gsum 'bud/ de nas rlung gi phugs rdzogs nges pa zhig drag la ring bar rngubs ste/ lte 'og tu hril gyis bskyur la/ de dang dus mtshungs par 'og rlung yang bsdams te/ kha sbyar la ha cang mig bcun par rang sar seng nge bzung la khebs tshad du dgag /de mi thub pa dang*/ lan gcig lan gnyis (257)gzhil la de mi thub pa dang btang*/ de la dbug 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu byas pa phreng dog re bskyur ba'am/ pus mo gnyis po la lag pa mi drag par bskor zhing se gol re gtogs pa de lta bu sum cu so drug khegs na bum pa can chung ngu*/

bdun cu rtsa gnyis khegs na bum pa can 'bring*/ brgya rtsa brgyad khegs na bum pa can rab bo// de'ang dang po sbyong ba'i dus su rlung so ma ji tshad khegs bltas la/ de'i thog tu zhag re dbugs khug pa re re yun gyis ring bar mnan te/ bum pa can rab 'bring tha gsum nas khegs khegs sbyang ngo*/ 'pho ba las su rung nas nam dga' dgar 'pho ba la bum pa can 'byongs pa gal che'o// de ltar bum pa can 'byongs nas 'pho ba sbyong ba la gsum/ sbyang ba dngos dang log gnon dang*/ tshe sring ba'i dmigs pa'o// dang po dus kyi gnad/ ston la sogs pa'i nam zla bzang po la/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad la/ zas bcud can gyis khams brtas par byas la/ lus kyi gnad rkang pa skyil krung bca'/ lag pas non/ rked pa drang por bsrang*/ mgrin par drang zhing sgu bar bya/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag gi gnas la/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed de/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor bsgom par bya snyams du sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lha ru bsam/ bla ma dam pa spyi bo'i gtsug tu gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du bsgom/ lte bar hūm̐ dmar po bye ru'i kha dog lta bu nas gang ba gcig bsam/ de gsang gnas su lhan gyis babs pa las 'od zer bung ba'i mtshon cha lta bu 'phros pas/ lus kyi nang cha dang mi gtsang ljan ljin sdig sgrib nad gdon thams (258)cad bsregs te nang bse rta'i rkyal pa kha phye ba bzhin dmar sang stong sang song bar bsam/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ bsgril ma re chad cing gshang lam dang chu so dang*/ lte ba dang kha dang sna dang mig dang rna ba dang*/ smin mtshams rnams hūm̐ bsgril ma res dgag /spyi gtsug rgya mthong kha phye ba bzhin ha re bzhag /de ltar lus stong pa'i dkyil na yar rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/

mda' smyug tsam gcig yar rtse spyi gtsug tu zug /mar rtse gsang ba'i gnas su zug pa gcig bsam/ de'i nang na yar hūm̐ dmar po de shig gi 'gros tsam du gu lu lu byung nas/ lte bar dbugs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu byas pa'i yun tsam gcig ngal gso// yang dal bus phyin te snying khar de tsam gcig ngal gso// mgrin par de tsam gcig ngal gso// de nas dal bus spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar tur gyis thon nas bla ma'i thugs khar sib kyis song bas/ bla ma dang hūm̐ tha mi dad par skya ka'i gnam 'phang bzhin yar rgyangs rgyangs song nas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas rdo ar mo li ka'i steng na phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la phyad de bzhugs pa la/ dbugs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gcig tu byas pa bcu'i yun tsam gcig rig pa gtad/ yang bla ma spyi bo'i gtsug tu dal bus mar byon te/ bla ma'i bshang lam nas hūm̐ tur gyis thon nas tshangs bug nas zhugs te dbu ma'i nang nas dal bus babs nas lte 'og tu gnas pa la/ dbugs lnga'i yun tsam zhig rig pa gtad/ yang gong bzhin dal bus yar 'don/ mar dbab/ de lta bu nus chad du bsgom zhing*/ rlung bum pa can nus tshad du bzung ngo// de ltar rtsa dbu ma gsal bas hūm̐ gis yar 'gro mar 'gro byed pa dang*/ dal bus byed pas rlung log dang gegs mi yong ba yin/ hur phyur byas na rlung log 'ong*/ de ltar thun bzhir sbyong zhing 'phro gcod pa'i dus su/ spyi bor bla (259)mas tshang bug mi mngon par dgag /hūm̐ lte 'og tu babs pa la rig pa yun ring gtad/ rlung ro mang du bus te/ rig pa sems kyi so bzung la/ dal bus langs te spyod lam bya'o// de ltar sbyangs pas 'byongs pa'i rtags rab spyi bo 'bur ba'am/ 'bring chu ser tshig pa'am/ 'gul ba'am/ tha ma yang g.ya' ba'am za ba'am na zug nam byung byung gi bar du bsgom mo// gnyis pa de ltar rtags byung ba dang log gnon bsgom pa ni/

gong bzhin hūm̐ dang bla ma tha mi dad/ rdo a mo li ka'i steng na phyag rgya chen po la bzhugs pa la dbugs lnga'i yun tsam zhig rig pa gtad/ dbu ma'i mar sna lte 'og tu babs pa la bcu'i yun tsam zhig rig pa gtad/ de nas rim gyis ya gir je thung ma kir ji ring la gtad de/ bla ma'i thugs khar thim song tsam la/ bla ma yar mi 'debs par hūm̐ dbu mar dbab/ de nas spyi bo tsam de nas mgrin pa tsam/ de las mar phab la mthar lte 'og tu lhan chags pa tsam la rig pa yun ring du gtad de/ rlung bum pa can bzung zhing zug chag nas kyang zhag gsum gyi bar la bsgom mo// gsum pa tshe ring ba'i dmigs pa bsgom pa ni/ lus stong ra'i nang du rtsa dbu ma gsal bar dmigs la/ de'i nang du hūm̐ dmar po nas gang bde yar zad spyi gtsug la thug /mar zang 'og sgor lhan song bar bsam zhing rlung bum pa can bzung*/ de la nges pa kho nar zhag bdun bsgom gsung*/ de ltar sbyong ba/ log gnon/ tshe sring ba'i dmigs pa gsum zhag nyer gcig la sogs pa bsgom ste/ 'byongs pa'i nges pa thob pa dang*/ de nas gdams ngag la ma brjed tsam ma gtogs pa bsgom mi dgos te/ nam 'chi ba'i dus na las la sbyar bas chog go /gnyis pa las la sbyor ba la gsum/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i 'khyams pa'i rgyu dug gsum gyi spros pa bcad pa/ rnam par shes pa byang chub kyi gnas (260)nas gdon pa/ 'od gsal sems kyi rang so bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ nges ba'i 'chi rtags byung ste 'chi bar shes pa dang*/ 'dod chags kyi spros pa bcad de/ nang sems can la chags pa'i nye 'brel dang 'khor g.yogs dang rang lus la ma chag par bya/ phyi rdzas dang longs spyod la chags pa bdog pa thams cad spong dag bya zhing*/ dngos po gang la yang zhen pa med par blos btang*/ zhe sdang gi spros pa bcad de su dang su la yang zhe 'gras pa med par bya te/ mkhon gcug sbyangs/ gti mug gi spros pa bcad de/

nad dang zug dbang du mi btang bar rig pa drungs bton la/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes nyan dang nyams myong gang yod pa thams cad gsal gdab pa'o// gnyis pa rnam par shes pa byang chub kyi lam nas gdon pa ni/ gdan bzhi las/ dus su gyur na 'pho bya ste/ dus min lha rnams gsod par byed/ ces bas nam dga' dgar 'phos na lha bsad pa'i ltung ba 'ong*/ nges par 'chi ba'i dus la babs te 'byung bzhi dang*// dbang po thim nas/ dbugs cung zad rtseg cing dkar dmar gyi snang ba shar ba la 'pho bar bya ste/ 'khrul 'khor skyil krung sems lus bcos te 'pho ba'i 'dug stangs byas la byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed/ skad cig gis lus yi dam gyi lhar bsam/ spyi bo nas khru gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/ bla ma dang yi dam tha mi dad bzhugs par bsam/ lte ba'i 'og tu hūm̐ dmar po nas gang ba zhig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus kyi nang cha dang mi gtsang ba'i ljan ljin nyon mongs rnam rtog sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis bsreg par bsam/ de nas hūm̐ de las hūm̐ bsgril ma re chad cing*/ sgo brgyad po gong bzhin bkag la/ tshangs bug rgya mthongs kha phye ba bzhin (261)bzhag/ rje nā ro pa'i zhal nas/ sgo brgyad 'khor ba'i skar khung can/ sgo gcig phyag rgya chen po'i lam/ sgo brgyad bkag nas sgo gcig 'byed/ ming yang 'pho ba'i gdams ngag zer/ rlung dus su khegs sam lo tsā ba// ces pa'i don no// de nas 'chi ka'i rlung bzlog pa dka' na yang*/ shad pa gcig nang du zlog la ting nge 'dzin gyis/ hūm̐ de la lus sems thams cad bsdus te/ de gyen la drag tu song nas tshang bug nas rgyangs thon te/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang gi sems dbyer med du 'dres pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rig pa lhan gyis gtad la rlung drag tu gyen la phul bas/ bum pa can thun gcig gis 'pho'o// des kyang ma 'phos na dmigs pa mar mi dbab par rlung shad pa gcig bzlog la drag tu gyen la phul bas/

gnyis pa las cis kyang 'pho'o// 'chi ba'i rlung sems shing thog smin pa dang 'dra ba yin/ rdo rje gdan bzhi las/ hūm̐ gi nga ro drag po yis/ lus can rnams ni skrod par byed/ ces pa'i don no// gsum pa 'od gsal sems kyi rang so bzung ba ni/ de nas rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal 'char te/ de dang gong gi rang sems bla ma'i thugs gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag pa gnyis 'od gsal ma bu 'phrod de/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang 'phrad pa bzhin ngo shes/ bye ma dang chu sna 'phrad pa bzhin gcig tu 'dres/ chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin dbyer med par gyur te/ de'i ngang la zhag bdun gnas nus na de nas phar tshegs med/ de la zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu gnas nus na/ mthong spang dang bsgom spang gi sgrib pa ma lus pa sbyangs te/ 'chi ba chos sku'i zhing khams la sangs rgyas nas bar do gzugs sku'i zhing khams la snang ba 'char ro// rab 'od gsal du 'pho ba/ 'bring sgyu lus su 'pho ba dang*/ tha ma gling dang skye gnas su 'pho ba dang*/ (262)de'i 'pho ba'i 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa/ 'pho ba'i gzhung khrid kyi tshar chos su shes par bya'o// 'pho ba hūm̐ dmar ma'i zhal gdams/ dpal yang dgon pa'i'o// dge'o// rgya rgya rgya/༄༅// na mo ratna gu ra be/ stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ni/ gzhi'i stong lugs gnyis/ lam gyi stong lugs gnyis/ 'bras bu'i stong lugs gnyis/ stong pa'i 'thad ldan gnyis/ stong pa gtan la dbab thabs gnyis/ stong pa'i skyon yon gnyis so// dang po ni/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa/ rnam pa kun ldan ces pa'i don ston pa ste/ spyir stong pa la/ yod pa la ltos pa'i med pa lta bu phyogs gcig pa'i stong pa/ ka pa li chos kyis stong pa'am/ bum pa chus stong pa lta bu nyi tshe ba'i stong pa dang*/ snang ba bkag pa'i stong pa lta bu dang*/ gcig pa bkag pa'i stong pa dang*/ stong pa dang stong pa'i rnam bzhag

/rnam grangs kyi stong pa la sogs pa/ mdor na stong pa ces pa med pa'am ma grub pa gcig la blo rtse gtad pa'i phyogs 'dzin gyi shes pa de rnams 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin la/ 'dir chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa de nyid chos can gyi dngos gzhir gnas pa la rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa zhes bya ste/ de yang rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud las/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ting 'dzin ni// stong pa nyid du rgyal bas bshad// gang gis stong nyid mi shes pa// de yis myang ngan 'das mi shes// gang phyir dngos dang dngos med pa// 'dzin pa stong nyid yin zhes brjod/ ces pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud las/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med// bcu drug phyed phyed thig le 'chang*/ zhes pa dang*/ sdud pa las/ yod dang med pa 'di gnyis med pa'i chos yin te/ byang chub sems dpa' (263)gang gis 'di shes mngon par 'byung*/ ces pa la sogs pa gsungs te/ mdor na nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i brjod par bya ba'i don gyi snying po// stong pa nyid yin de ma rtogs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'thob pas nyan rang gi byang chub mngon du byed par bshad do// de la gzhi'i stong lugs gnyis ni/ yod dang med pas stong la rtag dang chad pas stong*/ snang dang stong pas stong la gcig dang du mas stong*/ ces pa ste/ sher snying las/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid kyang gzugs so// gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no// ces pa ste/ de'ang gzugs stong pa'o ces pa ni/ yod pas stong*/ rtag pas stong*/ snang bas stong*/ du mas stong*/ dngos pos stong pa'i stong pa yin la/ stong pa nyid gzugs so// ces pa ni/ med pas stong*/ chad pas stong*/ gcig gis stong*/ stong pas stong*/ dngos med kyis stong pa'i stong pa ste/ de gnyis sngon la snang bar shar nas/

de nas stong par thim pa'am/ sngon la stong pa yin la phyi nas snang bar shar ba lta bu ma yin te/ snang ba las logs na stong pa med cing*/ stong pa las logs na snang ba med pas/ snang stong gnyis 'du 'bral med par ste/ de nyid las gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin no// stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ ces so// de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba yang yin te/ dngos po'i chos su skye ba med pa ni gzugs stong pa/ dngos med kyi chos su 'gag pa med pa ni stong pa nyid kyi gzugs/ tha dad chos la gnas pa med pa ni gzugs las kyang stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin pa'o// mdor na chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa ste/ yod pa'ang ma yin/ med pa'ang ma yin/ rtag pa'ang ma yin/ chad pa'ang ma yin/ snang (264)ba yang ma yin/ stong pa'ang ma yin/ dngos po'ang ma yin/ dngos med kyang ma yin/ 'khor ba'ang ma yin/ 'das pa'ang ma yin te/ phyogs gcig tu ci yang yin pas stong la/ phyogs gcig tu ci yang ma yin pas phyogs med du ci yang yin pa ste/ de nyid la rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa zhes bya'o// des na stong pa dang rten 'brel dbyer med pa ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ gnyis med rten cing 'brel par 'byung*/ 'gog pa med pa skye med pa/ ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs te/ de'ang chos nyid ci yang ma yin pas stong pa/ chos can cir yang 'char bas stong pa ste/ cir yang ma yin pas cir yang 'char la/ cir yang 'char bas cir yang ma yin te dbyer med pa'o// des na stong pa nyid rten 'brel du ma go na chad ltar 'gro la/ rten 'brel stong nyid du ma go na/ las rgyur smra bar 'gro bas/ de gnyis gnad gcig gis gtan la 'bebs pa 'di shin tu zab pa'i brjod bya ste/ de'i don mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas yang mang du gsungs te/ klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa ma yin no// de phyir stong nyid ma gtogs pa'i// chos gzhan yod pa ma yin no// ces tha mi dad par gsungs pa dang*// zla ba sgron ma'i mdo las/

gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i dngos po yod ma yin// rkyen la rags las gang de stong pa de// gang gis stong nyid shes na mkhas par bshad// ces pa dang*/ klu sgrub kyis/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba gang*// de ni stong pa nyid du 'dod// de ni rkyen las skye ba ste// de ni dbu ma'i lam yin no/ zhes stong pa rten 'brel du bshad pa dang*// nam mkha' che las khyad par cir yang mtshungs pa la// las so zhes ni rnam par btags// ci ste las kyi dbang gyur na// rang byung ye shes yod ma yin// ces rgyu 'bras (265)stong par bshad pa'o// de ltar chos nyid ci yang ma yin zhing*// ci la yang mi gnas pas/ tha snyad kyi gdags pa ma rnyed cing*/ blo'i yul du byar ma btub pa de la stong nyid ces bya/ de bzhin nyid ces bya/ skye med/ spros bral/ 'od gsal/ don dam pa'i bden pa/ chos dbyings sam/ chos nyid ces pa ming gi rnam grangs te/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o// gnyis pa lam gyis stong lugs gnyis ni/ sgom dang tha mal gyis stong lta dang lta min stong*/ phya dang mi byed 'khor gsum kun du stong*/ ces pa ste/ dang po lta ba dang lta min gyis stong pa rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa ni/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gtan la phebs pas nga'i lta ba 'di yin ces pa yongs gcod kyis bsgrub bya med pas lta bas stong la/ 'di min ces pa rnam gcod kyi dgag bya med pas lta min gyis stong ste/ phyogs 'dzin gyi lta ba thams cad las grol ba'o// de'ang klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid kyi lta thob kyang*/ la la'i lta ba ma zhig na/ gsor mi rung ba'i lta ba can/ sman pas bor ba'i nad pa bzhin/ ces pa dang*/ ārya de bas/ lta ba thams cad 'joms mdzad pa'i// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal lo// ces pa dang*/ rdo rje gur las/

lta ba rnams las bzlog pa dang*// bdag tu lta ba tshol rnams kyi// bdag zhen bsam pa bzlog pa'i phyir// stong par rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs// ces gsungs pas/ gong gi phyogs gcig tu ci yang ma yin la phyogs med du ci yang yin pa'i gnad kas 'dir lta ba 'di yin 'di min gyi gza' gtad med pas/ mtha' brgyad kyi phyog 'dzin rang grol ba ni lta ba phyin ci ma log pa'o// bla ma zhang gis/ yin pa gang yang med pa la/ ma yin pa yang gang yang med/ yin pa dang ni min pa gnyis/ (266)phan tshun ltos par 'dzin pa ste/ ltos pa zad la lta ba med/ ces pa'i don no// sgom gyis stong pa tha mal gyis stong pa'i sgom pa rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa ni sems rang lugs bzhag pas rnam par rtog pa rang 'gags pa'i dus na ngos bzung med pa'i shes pa sgro btags kyi spros pa dang bral bas sgom gyis stong la rang rig yul med du gsal ba la rtog med du nges shes skyes pas tha mal gyis stong pa'o// yang 'di bsgom mo zhes blos byas pa'i bsgom rgyu gcig kyang mi 'dug pas bsgom gyis stong la// 'di bsgom min no zhes spong bya'am dor bya mi 'dug pas tha mal gyis stong pa ste/ stong nyid bsgoms pas grol 'gyur gyis/ sgom pa lhag ma de don yin/ ces pa'i don no// bya byed kyi stong pa'am mi byed pas stong pa'i spyod pa rnam pa kun ldan ni// bya ba byed pas stong ste// sbyin pa la sogs nyams su len pa'i dus nyid na/ gtang bya'i yul/ gtong mkhan gyi bdag /btang ba'i phan yon gsum rang gi ngo bos stong zhing yod ma myong la/ bya ba mi byed pas stong ste/ stong pa nyid sbyin pa la sogs pa bsod nams kyi phung por shar cing*/ ma 'gags cing ya ma bral spyod pa'o// de ltar bya ba byed ltar ma 'gags/ bya ba byed mkhan ngo bos stong pa'i bya ba byed pa dang mi byed pa bcing grol med pa'i stong nyid de/

'gags pa gtsug na rin po che'i mdo las/ de la rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid gang zhe na/ gang sbyin pa dang ma bral ba/ tshul khrims dang ma bral ba/ bzod pa dang ma bral ba/ brtson 'grus dang ma bral ba/ bsam gtan dang ma bral ba/ shes rab dang ma bral ba/ thabs dang ma bral ba'o// ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs pa'i don no// de lta bu'i lam rnam pa mchog ldan gyi stong pa ste/ thabs shes rab/ don dam kun rdzob/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim la (267)sogs pa dbyer med pa ste/ phyogs gcig tu zhen pa las grol ba'i lam ma nor cing rnam par dag pa'o// de ltar lam sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba zung 'jug rab tu mi gnas pa dbu ma'i lam nyams su blangs pas/ 'bras bu srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i byang chub chen po mngon du byed pa'o// gsum pa 'bras bu'i stong lugs gnyis ni/ snang dang snang med ye shes rgyun gyis stong*/ rtog dang rtog med 'khor dang 'das pas stong*// ces pa ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la snang bas stong ste/ zhen pas brtas pa'i 'khrul snang mi mnga'/ snang med kyis stong ste/ rang snang rang ngo shes pa ye shes kyi snang ba la 'gag pa med/ ye shes yod pas stong ste/ yod pa dngos can gyi yang dag zhig grub pa med/ med pas stong ste yod med sgro skur gyi mtha' dang bral ba de nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi dngos gzhir bzhugs/ rtog pas stong ste/ sems dang sems las byung ba'i rnam shes dang*// 'du shes kyi rnam rtog mi mnga'/ yul dang yul can gyi thugs rje dang phrin las mi mnga'/ rtog med kyis stong ste nyan thos kyi 'gog pa'i 'bras bu lta bu ma yin par/ so sor kun du rtog pa'i ye shes kyis shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas shing dus gsum mngon sum du mkhyen la/ dmigs med kyi snying rjes rtsol med kyi phrin las srid mtha'i bar du 'byung ba'o// 'khor bas stong ste shes rab chen pos srid pa la mi gnas/

'das pas stong ste snying rje chen pos zhi ba la mi gnas pa'o// de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i nyes pa zad pa'i sangs rgyas de la 'ga' zhig 'khrul snang gzhi dang lam gyi shes sgrib bkab nas snang ba yod med dang ye shes rgyun chad ma chad dang*/ rtog pa yod med la sogs pa la rtsod pa (268)'byung bar 'dug ste/ phyogs gcig gi mur 'dzin pa de dag gis 'bras bu rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa nyid go ba min na// rdo rje gcod pa'i mdo las/ gang dag nga la gzugs su mthong*/ gang gis nga la sgrar shes pa// log par mthong la zhugs pa yi// skye bo des ni nga mi mthong*// 'dren pa rnams ni chos kyi sku// chos sku mthong bya ma yin no// ces pa'i don no// bzhi pa stong pa'i 'thad ldan ni/ stong dang rten 'byung dbyer med dag sdig 'bras bu 'byin/ thams cad stong pa yin phyir 'khrul snang ldog tu btub/ ces pa ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyis rkyen gyis cir yang 'char cing cir yang byar btub pa ste/ bsam pa'i rang gzugs bag chags kyi gzugs brnyan/ stong pa las stong pa'i chos 'byung ba dkar nag gi rgyu 'bras til 'bru tsam yang chud mi za zhing*/ ma 'dres par 'bras bu 'byin pa ste/ phyogs gcig tu ci yang min pas/ phyogs med cir yang 'char bas na/ kun rdzob kyi chos 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras ji snyed pa thams cad kyang stong nyid yin pas 'byung ba'o// yang chos thams cad kyi chos nyid stong pa nyid yin pa'i gnad kyis/ 'khrul pa ldog cing mya ngan las 'dar yang btub pa ste chos thams cad la rtag brtan ther zug mi 'gyur ba'i dngos po ko 'thas yang dag tu grub pa gang yang med pas/ sdig pa bshags su btub la/ dge ba bsngo ru btub/ 'khrul snang ldog tu btub pa ste/ sdig pa la rang bzhin med cing ma grub par shes pa ni/ sdig pa bshags pa'i mchog yin la/

dge ba rang bzhin med cing ma grub par shes pa ni zag med kyi dge ba'i mchog yin zhing*/ chos thams cad rang bzhin med cing ma grub pa ni chos sku'i dngos gzhir gnas cing*/ de de ltar shes pa ye shes te/ mdor na stong nyid rang bzhin med pa'i gnad kyis sangs rgya ru btub la/ mi rgya (269)ba'i rang dbang med pa'o// stong pa dang mi rtag pa yang phugs gcig ste/ de nyid chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa yin la/ chos nyid de dus las 'das cing*/ de nyid shes pa'i ye shes de dus la dbang sgyur bas/ dus bskal pa dang skad cig ma la khyad med pa dang*/ dus gsum dang dus mngon du mkhyen pa dang*/ snang ba la dbang sgyur bas stong gsum nyungs 'byung tshud pa dang*/ ba pu'i bu ga nas zhing khams bye ba 'gyed pa la sogs pa'i stong nyid ci yang ma yin pa'i gnad kyis 'byung ba ste/ lugs bzlog mya ngan las 'das pa'i rten 'brel thams cad stong nyid yin pa'i gnad kyis 'byung ba'o// rgyal ba'i yum las/ gzugs rtag brten ther zug mi 'gyur ba'i dngos po zhig yin na ni/ theg pa chen po 'dis kyang lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten zil gyis mnan cing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// ces pa la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so// lnga pa stong pa de gtan la dbab lugs kyi tshig rkang gnyis ni/ ma byas yul med rang stong lhan cig skyes/ gdod nas yod pa bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ ces pa ste/ stong nyid de yang mchog gsum dang ldan pa ste/ rang stong*/ ye stong*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pa'o// rang stong pas yul med de/ stong bya phyi ru bzhag nas/ stong mkhan nang du lus pa lta bu ma yin te/ snang rig rang stong pa'o// ye stong pa dus blo bur du ma byung ba ste/ sngon la snang ba 'byung ba la de nas stong pa song ba lta bu ma yin te/ gdod ma nas stong zhing*/ dngos po'i chos su skye ma myong ba'o// rang bzhin gyis stong pa ni byed pa po gzhan gyis ma byas pa ste/

sangs rgyas kyis bcos nas stong du bcug pa'am/ sems can gyis sbyangs nas stong du bcug pa'am/ lam gyis sbyangs nas stong du bcug pa'am/ bla ma gdams ngag che nas byas ba'am/ slob ma shes rab che nas byas pa'am/ snang ba bkag nas stong pa bsgrubs (270)pa lta bu ma yin te/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis stong*/ ngo bos stong pa dus gsum dus med pas stong pa/ snang ba'i dus nyid na ngo bos stong pa nyid do// brgyad stong pa las/ rab 'byor gzugs gzugs kyi ngo bo nyid kyis stong ste/ rang gi mtshan nyid kyis stong pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ ces rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ yab sras mjal ba las/ chos 'di thams cad ni dus gsum du mnyam pa nyid kyis mnyam pa dag ste/ 'das pa'i dus na'ang chos thams cad ngo bo nyid med pas na da ltar byung ba'i bar du ngo bo nyid dang bral ba'o// ces gsungs pa'o// de lta bu'i stong pa de dngos po'i chos thams cad dang gnyis su med par rang gi ngo bo'i lhan cig skyes pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ lhan cig skyes pa gang skyes pa// lhan cig skyes par de brjod bya// rang bzhin lhan skyes zhes brjod de// rnam pa thams cad sdom par gcig /ces pa'i don no// de lta bu'i stong nyid lhan cig skyes pa de tha snyad kyis gtan la mi phebs shing*/ rtog ge ba'i spyod yul ma yin pas/ thos bsam gyi shes rab kyis don spyi'i rnam pa tsam gtan la phebs su zin kyang*/ rang mtshan mngon sum du rtogs par mi 'gyur bas/ bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyi brda' thabs khyad par can la brten nas skye ba'i mtshan mas skye med rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ dngos po'i chos la brten nas stong pa'i chos nyid rtogs par 'gyur la/ ye nas yod pa'i ye shes khong nas sad par byed do// drug pa stong pa'i skyon yon gnyis la/ rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug dngos po'i gshis/ med pa'i stong pa 'dra men nor sar nor/

ces pa ste/ rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa phyogs gcig gis stong pa sogs spros pas dben pa'i rang bzhin de ni/ dngos po'i gnas lugs dngos po'i gshis yin la/ de ji lta bar rtogs pa'i shes rab ni/ myur du 'khor ba las sgrol zhing*/ (271)mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byed pa yin no// klu sgrub kyis/ yod pa po ni bde 'gror 'gro// med pa po ni ngan 'gror 'gro// yang dag ji bzhin yongs shes ni// gnyis la mi brten thar par 'gyur// ces pa dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ byams sogs rmongs dang 'gal med phyir// nyes pa shin tu tshar gcod min// nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// de yang 'jigs tshogs lta las byung*// stong nyid lta dang de 'gal bas// de las byung ba'i nyes kun spong*// ces pa dang*/ mdo dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ skal pa dman pas chos 'di la// the tshom tsam zhig skyer mi nus// the tshom tsam zhig skyes pas kyang*// srid pa hrul por byed pa nyid// ces pa la sogs pa gsungs pas/ gnas lugs kyi gshis stong pa nyid du bzhugs pa yin la/ de ma nor bar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis/ las thams cad zag pa med par sgrub cing*// myur du 'khor ba las grol cing*// mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du byed pa'o// med pa'i stong pa 'dra men nor sar nor/ ces pa ni/ stong pa dang med pa 'dra men gyi nor sar nor ba yin pas/ stong pa zhes pa cang med phyang chad gcig tu go na/ blo gros rmongs shing lta ba shin tu nor ba ste/ de la dgongs nas/ sdud pa las/ phung 'di stong zhes rtogs na'ang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ mtshan ma la spyod skye med gnas la dad ma yin/ ces dang*/ sa ra has dngos por rtog pa phyugs dang 'dra bar brjod/ dngos med rtog pa de bas kyang ni blun/ ces pa dang*/ yum las/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang ces pa la sogs pa mang du gsungs/ klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur// ji ltar sprul la bzung nyes dang*// rig sngags log par sgrub pa bzhin// ces pa dang*/

chos spyod mngon rtogs las// stong pa'i bdag po (272)stong pa'i 'gro// ces pa la sogs pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams nas mang du gsungs te/ de thams cad stong pa med pa'i phyogs su 'dzin pa/ chad par lta ba la nyes/ thabs la skur pa 'debs pa rnams la dgongs pa yin te/ stong pa dang med pa ma nor bar rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong pa gnyis med rten cing 'brel 'byung gi don khong du chud par bya'o// yang rgyal ba'i yul las/ stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'dres par bya'o// stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du mi bya'o// ces pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ seng ge gang la'ang mi 'jigs mod// me chen byung na 'jigs pa skyes// de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yang*// chos gzhan gang la'ang mi 'jigs kyang*// stong pa nyid la 'jigs pa skye// ces pa gsungs pa'i don yang go bar bya'o// stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug ma'i zhal gdams che long tsam yi ger bkod pa'o// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ snang dang stong pas stong la rtog dang chad pas stong*// yod dang med pas stong la gcig dang du mas stong*/ 1 /bsgom dang tha mal gyis stong lta dang lta min stong*// bya dang mi byed 'khor gsum kun du stong*/ 2 /rtog dang rtog med 'khor dang 'das pas stong*// snang dang snang med ye shes rgyun gyis stong*/ 3 /stong dang brten 'byung dbyer med dge sdig 'bras bu 'byin// thams cad stong pa yin phyir 'khrul snang ldog tu btub/ 4 /ma byas yul med rang stong lhan cig skyes// ye nas yod pa bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ 5 /rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug dngos po'i gshis// med pa'i stong pa 'dra min nor sar nor/ 6 /stong nyid rdo rje'i tshig drug bya ba don dam pa rnal du ston pa'i ye ge*/ ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che dang zhang rin po che skye ba 'ga'i dpon slob yin gsungs/

de lta yang rtsa ba'i bla ma dang mnyam pa'i mos gus yod pas/ dus mchod kyang khrig ge mdzad/ (273)rtog pa la bogs med tsa na yang gsol ba 'debs/ byang chub kyi sems la bogs 'don pa dang*/ rmi lam sbyang ba la sogs pa'i dus su yang gsol ba 'debs gsungs/ spyir yang mtshan mo rmi lam du zhal mang du 'jal bas/ zhang gi chos tsho la brgyud pa gzhan la bda' mi dgos/ zhang rin po ches rgyud byin gyi rlabs pa yin gsungs/ da lta yang gsol ba nam btab pa'i dus su mjal ba la the tshom mi za bar gda' 'o// da res 'dir ji ltar mjal na/ ras sngon mda' ru rje rin po che sku 'khor shas gcig gis bzhugs pa'i dus su/ sngar yum bzhugs pa la yum dgon par gshegs pa'i nub mo kha ba gcig byung*/ der rin po che'i thugs la nga dga'o mi rgyal bar 'dug ste/ gan mo lhang nang 'phreng yin yod snyam pa gcig byung*/ des rkyen byas nas ma'i drin dran/ der de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi ma byas pa'i drin dran pas byams snying rje bsam gyis mi khyab ba thugs la 'khrungs spyan chab dpag tu med pa byung*/ smon lam dpag tu med pa btab/ de'i dus su lam du btang shes nang 'gro don gyi rten 'brel de kas 'grigs pa la/ ngas ma shes par pha ro myangs gsungs/ de'i mthar thug tha mal nyin zhag gcig ting nge 'dzin la phyams song nas/ nye gnas pas tsha ba drangs pa yang phyag tu bzhes pa byung 'dug ste gsol ba ma byung 'dug /de nas dar cig rtsa na/ nyi bzhur thal le ba gcig yud byung*/ yang de ma thag phyams song*/ de'i bar la nye gnas pas 'bod ni ma nus/ yang yang bskor/ dgong mor song ba dang khong tshos skor ba'i rdog sgras ting nge 'dzin sa de nas der rnam rtog gi sbun thag chad nas/ gsal stong du rjen par rtogs pa'i bogs nyams kyis bton khor yug tu song*/ sgom med chen po yin snyam pa'i thag chod pa byung*/ de nas chos mang po gcig gi sgro 'dogs chod/

gegs sel gzer lnga'i lha 'dre lam du khyer ba'i skabs su/ lha 'dre pha ma yin/ bla ma yin/ yi dam yin/ lhan skyes yin gsungs pa las/ 'di ltar yin bya ba mi 'dug /lam du 'khyer (274)lugs gcig yod snyam nas zhang rin po che la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i nub mo mtshan lam na/ na bkra'i brag rked yin snyam bzhig na// spang khud ser sding nge ba zhig na/ bla ma zhang rin po che khri gcig gi la na bzhugs/ dar thod gcig mdzad/ gdugs dkar po gcig phub/ bud med gnyis kyis g.yas g.yon nas brten nas mdun na btsun pa 'dra ba shas gcig dang*/ mi skya 'dra ba dang mtha' ma na sprang po 'dra ba'i zhas zhis 'dra 'dug pas/ ngas des dga' ba dang mos gus thun mong ma yin pas phyag mang du btsal/ drung du phyin pas bla ma zhang zhal zas kyi bye brag gcig gsol gin 'dug pas/ nga la yang rgun 'brum 'ol 'dra ba'i che chung rgun 'brum tsam byas pa'i sprin sprin pa'i 'di yin ngo mi shes pa zhig gnang*/ de gsol bas ro mngar shul phril ba/ sngar ljags la 'jog ma myong ba'i ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa zhig byung*/ nang par mnal sad tsa na yang de'i ro de ljags dang tshems kyi bar du chags nas zhag 'ga' zhig byung*/ da lta yang khams nam bza' tsa na yod gsungs/ de'i dus su gsang spyod rmong lam ma gnang ba'o// de'ang*/ lha 'dre stong pa'i gzugs brnyan 'di// lam du khyer ba 'di ltar ro// pha ma yin gyis byams bsgoms// bla ma yin gyis gsol ba thob// yi dam yin gyis dngos grub zhus// lhan skyes yin gyis ngang la zhog gsungs// de'i 'drog la mnal sad nas chos rnam ba bzhi la brten nas/ lha 'dre lam du 'khyer tshul gyi gsang spyod 'di thugs la lam me shar nas 'dug /gzhan yang sku'i bkod pa dang 'khor gyi byed pa de rnams la go rgyu mang po zhig byung*/ de ltar lha 'dre lam du 'khyer ba thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang spyod 'di la lha 'dre lam du slong tshul bzhi ste/

lha 'dre pha mar shes pas kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis lam du byed ba byams pa chen po'i gsang spyod dang*/ yi dam du shes pas (275)kun rdzob bskyed rim lha'i 'khor los lam du byed pa sgyu lus zhing sbyong gi gsang spyod dang*/ bla mar shes pas lam zab mo mos gus gyis lam du byed pa dag snang kun khyab kyi gsang spyod dang*/ chos skur shes pas gnyis med phyag rgya chen pos lam du byed pa snang srid rgya thegs kyi gsang spyod do// de re re la gnyis gnyis te spyir lha 'dre lam du slong tshul dang*/ khyad par du gsang spyod nyams su blang tshul lo// dang po ni/ don dam pa'i gshis la lha 'dre dang sangs rgyas dang sems can dang*/ rang dang gzhan snang la sogs pa'i gnyis snang thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis ma skyes shing rnam par dag pas/ dus gsum du yod ma myong ba yin yang de tsam kyis lha 'dre lam du mi bslongs pas/ don dam par lha 'dre ma grub pas bslang bya slong byed kyang ma grub la/ kun rdzob tu lha 'dre med byas na skur 'debs su gol bas de yang ji srid rang du 'dzin pa yod kyi bar du lha 'dre yang yod la/ de yang rang dang lha 'dre gnyis ka la rtag brtan ther zug mi 'gyur ba'i dngos po med pas/ btags chags ltar snang ba sgrubs 'grub yin tshul nges pa med la rkyen gyis cir yang 'char ba ste/ rang tha mal gyi rnam rtog dug gsum rang kha mar yod pa'i dus na/ de'i rang gzugs lha 'dre yang gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs su yod la/ rang theg pa chen po'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong ba'i dus na/ lha 'dre drin can gyi pha mar yod la/ rang smin byed bum pa'i dbang thob nas grol byed bskyed rim lam du byed pa'i dus na/ lha 'dre yi dam gyi lhar yod la/ rang rdzogs rim kyi snying po mos gus gtsor byed pa'i dus na/

lha 'dre bla ma sku gsum gyi rang bzhin du yod la/ rang smin byed dbang bzhi thob nas grol byed phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i dus na/ lha 'dre de lhan skyes rang byung gi ye shes su yod pa ste/ (276)nang gi sems kyi byed pa ji lta ba bzhin/ phyi rol gyi snang ba yang der snang bas/ snang ba rang sems bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin la/ rang tha mal la sems can lha 'dre gnod byed gdon bgegs yang dag tu grub pa med pas/ rkyen gyis cir yang 'char du btub ste/ chos thams cad kyi chos nyid stong pa nyid yin la/ kun rdzob kyi chos nyid de nyid don dam pa ste/ bden gnyis dbyer med pa'o// de la dang po byang chub kyi sems kyis lha 'dre lam du byed pa ni/ theg pa chen po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la blo sbyong ba'i rnal 'byor pa la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa gang yang med de/ de re res kyang lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par pha ma byas cing*/ lus longs spyod la ltos pa med par bskyangs pa'i drin can gyi pha ma yin la/ de nyid mdo nas rgya cher gsungs pa ste/ lung de dgongs pa can ma yin par ston pa la/ klu sgrub kyis kyang gsal por gsungs te/ drin can gyi pha ma de rnams sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gdungs pa la/ phan 'dogs gnod skyob bde ba la sbyor ba'i drin lan ldon dgos/ de la pha ma yin pa'i lha 'dre la zhe sdang breng pa gcig byung na/ sems bskyed rgyas kyang ma thob/ blo sbyong byas kyang ma 'byongs pa yin/ da lha 'dre yin na pha ma yin/ pha ma yin na lha 'dre min pas/ de thams cad pha ma ru shes shing blo sna gzhan don du sbyong ba'i lta ba'i go cha gyon/ da lha 'dre'i bar chad gnod pa byung ba'i dus su 'di ltar lam du btang ste/ lha 'dre'i bar chad dam gnod pa de nyid rang gnang du byang chub kyi sems la ltem rkyang byung zhing*/

dus gsum gyi rtog pa skyes pa'i rang gzugs yin pas/ skyon gyis sa bon rang la yod pa shes par byas la de la gnad du bsnun pa ni/ lus 'khrul 'khor du gnas la tshad med pa bzhi'i sgo nas byang chub (277)kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ spyir nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bdag gi ma yin/ sgos gnod cing bar chad byed pa'i gnod byed kyi lha 'dre 'di rnams bdag gi ma yin/ dri'ang lan grangs bsam gyis mi khyab par ma byas cing*/ ma byed pa'i dus na bde sdug gtam ngan gsum la ma bltas par lus longs spyod la ltos pa med par bskyangs pas shin tu dran che/ drin can gyi ma yin snyam du drin rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ bdag gi drin can gyi ma 'di rnams la ji ltar phan 'dags/ ji ltar drin lan glan/ ji ltar bde ba la dgod/ ma 'di rnams bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya'o// snyam du byams pa tshad med pa bsgom/ de ltar bdag gi drin can gyi ma 'di rnams 'dod bde ba 'dod kyang 'dug sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du 'dug /sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la gnas/ 'bras bu la spyod/ rkyen dang mi ldan pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje snyam du sems can gyi sdug bsngal rgyas par bsgom zhing*/ sdug bsngal 'di rnams las ji ltar byas la skyob/ gnod pa 'di rnams ji ltar bsal/ sems can 'di rnams sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya'o// snyam pa'i snying rje tshad med pa bsgom/ gnod byed kyi ma yis gtso byas pa'i sems can rnams bde ba dang ldan na re dga' ste/ sdug bsngal dang bral na dga' ste/ myur du byang chub thob na re dga' ste/ sems can 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral myur du sangs rgyas thob na rang nyid ji ltar song na yang song ste snyam pa'i dga' ba tshad med pa bsgom mo// de yang dgra zin nye ring med par mtho dman med par kun la snyams shing*/

dus rgyun chad med par btang snyoms tshad med pa bsgom/ de nas gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsdu zhing gzhan don du smon lam gdab pa ste/ bdag la lha 'dre'i bar chad dang gnod pa 'di la brten nas nam (278)mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dang skyon dang nyes pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig /lha 'dre 'di rnams kyis bdag la gnod pa'i bsam sbyor brtsams pa 'di nyid kyis nag po'i 'brel pa byas nas gnod pa'i sbyor ba/ dang*/ zhe sdang gi bsam pa zhi nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyis rgyud yongs su gang nas/ dus dang skye gnas thams cad du bdag gi gdul byar gyur nas theg pa chen po'i chos kyis smin pa dang grol bar byed par gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab cing blo sbyang*/ de nas gnod byed kyi lha 'dre ltar snang ba 'di nyid rang gi blos 'khrul pa'i snang dor shar ba yin gyi/ don dam pa shes bya'i gshis la skad cig kyang grub pa med cing yod ma myong la/ lha 'dre dang bar chad ltar snang ba'i dus nyid na rang ngo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i chos nyid du shes pas gnyis su med pa'i ngang la phyams kyis bzhag go /de ni don dam pa byang chub sems kyis lam du byed pa ste/ de ltar rang rgyud byang chub kyi sems su lhang shar ba'i dus na lha 'dre thams cad pha ma ru 'char zhing*/ gnod pa'i sbyor ba thams cad phan bde ru 'gro bar 'gyur ro// da rang las gdon nam gnod pa'i lha 'dre gdug pa can gyi zin pa yin na'ang*/ gong ma de rnams la phur tshugs su bsgoms pas myur du nad dang gdon las thar bar 'gyur te/ 'jig rten mgon po 'bri khung pa la/ e chung sgom phug tu mdze nad drag po byung ba'i dus su/ tshad med pa'i snying rje thugs la 'khrungs pas skad cig de nyid la bsnyung nad de dwangs shing*/ phyis kyang snying rje'i khrid des mdze pho mang po'i don mdzod de/

mdze 'ur 'ded ces yongs su grags pa'o// gzhan yang dgra thul ba dang nad sel ba dus gcig 'ong ste/ lha 'dre'i gnod ba'i bsam sbyor rgyun chad pa dang*/ lha 'dre de nyid gdul byar gyur pa dang*/ de la brten nas gzhan don bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sgo 'bye zhing*/ gong (279)gi tshad med pa bzhi po des phrin las bzhi yang 'grub ste/ byams pas zhi ba'i phrin las sdig sgrib nad gnon zhi ba dang*/ snying rjes drag po'i phrin las lha 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa 'char ba dang*/ dga' bas dbang gi phrin las gdon bgegs de dbang du 'du ba dang*/ btang snyoms kyis rgyas pa'i phrin las gdon de la brten nas yang tshad med pa'i lha 'dre'i don byed cing*/ 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags dang phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam par rgyas par 'gyur ba'o// yang sbyang gzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la sbyong byed tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pas/ 'jig rten pa'i mes po lha tshangs pa yin pas 'jig rten na de bas dbang che ba med cing*/ de thams cad de'i g.yog lta bu yin pa'i phyir du/ lha 'dre mthu bo che rnams dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad gdul byar 'gyur zhing*/ mthar thug rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal lta bu'am/ 'khor lo bde mchog lta bus sems can gyi don mdzad pa'ang de'i rang gzugs yin no// gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsdus pas blo sbyong gi bogs 'don cing*/ de la rang gi sems su shes pas dmigs pa med pa'i byang chub kyi sems su 'gyur zhing*// thams cad kyi yon tan gyi bde chos myur du bskyod pa'o// gnyis pa gsang spyod nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dang bdag 'dzin gyi ltos thag bcad pa dang*/ byang chub sems la bogs dbyung ba'i phyir/ gcod par phyin la ro mnyam zhing thag bcad do/ de'ang rang la lha 'dre gdon zer ba yod na de'i sa ru 'gro/ de ma yin na gang gnyan sa 'dre che ba'i sar phyin la/

de'i yangs dmigs sam gang 'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba ru phyin la mal bcas te/ lus 'khrul 'khor gnas la dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ byang chub kyi mchog dang sems bskyed/ de nas gnas bdag des gtso byas pa'i sems (280)can thams cad la gong gi tshad med pa bzhi po de snying thag pa nas nan tan bskyed la/ yun ring du gnad du btang*/ der 'jigs pa dang yang ba'i rtog pa byung na 'di sems can ma ru ma shes pas/ gnod byed 'dre gdon du bzung bas lan/ lus longs spyod la ltos pa med par gzhan don du ma thongs pas/ rang lus la bdag 'dzin skyes pas lan pas/ khyod kyi snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems kha tsam dang tshig tsam dang go yul du song nas 'dug pa/ khyod la blo sbyong gi skye tshul de las mi 'dug pa snyam du rang la thag bcad de skyon gyi rtsa ba bton la/ lha 'dre 'di ni drin can ma yin na/ pha mas 'jigs sam/ pha ma la bag tsha'am/ gzhi bdag gis gtsor byas ba'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad drin can pha ma yin pa la/ sngon chad drin lan gang yang ma lon pas/ da res lus 'di btang dgos snyam du bsam la/ snying rje dung ba gcig bsgoms la gzhi bdag des gtsor byas pa'i lha 'dre dpag tu med pa thibs kyis byung bar bsam/ de thams cad pha ma ru shes pas drin chen gyi ma khyed rnams la drin lan du stor bas sha dga' ba sha khyer/ khrag dga' ba khrag khyer/ rus pa dga' ba rus pa khyer/ so so ci 'dod pa khyer cig /da ltar nyid du khyer cig ces pas ltos pa med par thams cas la ling kyis bskyur la/ lus la sems kyi phyi mig kyang mi lta bar ses kyis bzhag ste/ sems byams pa chen po'am/ snying rje chen po'i ngang la phyams kyis yun ring du bzhag go /de nas gong ltar la 'dre rang sems su shes pas rang dang lha 'dre gnyis su med cing rang ngo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba don dam byang chub kyi sems la mnyam par bzhag la/

gnyid log pa dang sad pa dang*/ nyin par la sogs pa dus thams cad du byang chub kyi sems la rtse gcig bsgom zhing*/ khyad par lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung na rang gi byang chub kyi sems (281)la ltem brkyang byung zhing*/ 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa skyes pa'i rang gzugs yin snyam du shes pas gong ltar gnad du bsnun cing*/ lus lha 'dre la sbyin pa btang ba la nan tan bskyed/ sems byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la rtse gcig tu bsgom/ kun 'jug thams cad la smon lam rgya chen po mang du gdab cing*/ lha 'dre de dag gdul byar smon lam gdab/ chos kyi sbyin pa gtang*/ dkar po'i 'brel gdags/ gzhan don gyi rten 'brel bsgrig /de ltar ji srid rang gi 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang ya nga ba'i khu 'khrigs chod de/ snying rje byang chub kyi sems la sogs ma byung gi bar du bsgom/ gnyis pa bskyed rim lha'i 'khor los lha 'dre lam du slong tshul gnyis las/ dang po spyir lam du slong ba ni/ smin byed bum pa'i dbang thob nas grol byed bskyed rim sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud kyi sems can lha dang lha mo// tshor ba thams cad bde ba chen po yin te/ de la lha ma yin pa'i gnod byed bgegs shig gud du byung na bum dbang bskur yang ma thob la/ skyed rim bsgoms kyang ma 'byongs pas/ dus rnam pa thams cad du rang gzhan phung khams skye mched thams cad yi dam lha'i 'khor lor shes par bya ste/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig dang ma bral bar bya/ khyad par du rang la lha 'dre'i bar chad dam gnod pa byung na/ rang gi bskyed rim la ltem brkyang shor cing*/ tha mal gyi sgo gsum 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa'i rang gzugs yin pas/ skyon gyis sa bon rang du shes par byas la/ gnad du bsnun pa ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang ngam yi dam gyi lha ru bsgom/

nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad lha ru bsgom/ mdun du gnod byed kyi bgegs de yi dam du bsgom/ rang dang gnod byed gnyis ka'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du sa bon gyi yi ge (282)bsgom/ de nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun gyi gdon yi dam du yod pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas/ thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul nas/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer tshur 'phros pas/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dul rig pa gtad la bzlas pa bya'o// de'i byed las ni snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang du bsgoms pas 'bros mi nus pa yin/ bcud kyi sems can yi dam du bsgoms pas rdzu mi nus pa yin/ bgegs yi dam du bsgoms pas bsam sbyor phan bde ru ldog pa yin/ rang yi dam du sgom zhing*/ de thams cad dang gnyis su med pa chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag pas bgegs de rang gi dbang du 'du zhing*/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'du des de'i gnod pa'i bsam sbyor la nus pa skyes tshad mchog thun mong gi dngos grub tu 'gyur zhing de'i nus par 'char ro// bar chad kyi gdon bgegs zhes pas zin ther zug pa zhig yang dag tu grub pa med pas/ rang gi nang gi sems kyi byed pa ji ltar bltas pa bzhin du phyi rol du yang de ltar snang ste/ 'dre gdon du bltas na 'dre gdon du snang zhing de'i byed las gnod pa dang bar chad du 'gyur la/ yi dam du bltas na yi dam du snang zhing de'i byed las kyang dngos grub rnam gnyis su 'byung ste/ kun spyod las/ 'gro lnga 'di dag sangs rgyas mnga' bdag nyid/ gar mkhan dag dang ri mo mkhan ltar gnas/ gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ gcig pu'i nyams kyis su ma'i gar mdzad do// ces pa dang*/ rje btsun mi la'i zhal nas/

'khrul snang gdon bgegs cho 'phrul 'di// ma rtogs dus na lha 'dre yin// bar chad the tshom skyed par byed// rtogs pa'i dus na yi dam lha// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ster bar byed/ (283)don mtha' thug la lha dang 'dre ru med// ces pa ste// rang gi nang gi thugs dam gyi byed pas phyi rol du lha 'dre'i bar chod dang gnod pa thams cad phan 'dogs dang*/ dngos grub du 'char ba ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la bdud kyis mtshon cha'i char phab pa me tog gi char du gyur cig /mi snyan pa'i nga ro bstod pa'i tshigs bcad du gyur pa lta bu'o// des na yi dam min pa la yin par bsgom pa'i kun brtags lta bu ma yin te/ lha 'dre de nyid lus gzugs skur lhan cig skyes/ ngag longs skur lhan cig skyes/ sems chos skur lhan cig skyes/ lhan skyes yi dam gyi 'khor lor gnas pa la/ yin pa la yin par ngo shes par byed pa ste/ bskyed rim brten cig dag pa'i sgyu lus dang zhing khams sbyor bar 'gro/ sngar 'dre gdon tu lta ba rnams kyi gnod pa'i sbyor ba ltog cing*/ da 'dre gdon gyis mi tshugs cing*/ snang ba yi dam gyi lhar 'char ba'i gdams ngag yin no// gnyis pa rang gi bskyed rim zhing sbyong gi bogs dbyung zhing yang ba'i khu 'phrig 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa gzhom pa'i phyir gsang spyod nyams su blang ba ni/ rang la gdon stabs pa'am/ gang 'dra che zhing gnyan pa'i sa der phyin te/ rang lha'i nga rgyal brtan pas gzugs snang stong mthong tshad yi dam du lam lam bsgom zhing*/ rig pa ngar dang ldan pas phyin te/ gnyan sa de gzhal yas khang du bsgom/ gzhi bdag de yi dam du bsgom/ yi dam dang zhal mjal ba re dga' na/ snang ba thams cad yi dam gyi 'khor lo dang zhal mjal ba re dga' na snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod pas rig pa hur bun gyis btang la spros bcas drag po zhig bya'o// de nas gzhal yas khang de'i ya nga ba'am 'jigs 'jigs 'dra ba zhig tu mal bcas la/

gsum la skyabs 'gro dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ bla ma la gsol ba gdab/ de nas gong gi mngon (284)rtog bsgoms la 'od zer kyi 'phro 'du la rig pa gtad la/ bzlas pa bya ba'am/ yang na lha sku phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du bzhag go /de la yang yang dang khu 'phrigs kyi rtog pa byung na/ snang ba yi dam gyi 'khor lo yin/ gdon bgegs 'di ni yi dam gyi lha yin/ khyod yi dam gyi lhas 'jigs sam/ yi dam mngon sum du byung na dga'/ gsung rang mjal na dga' bas/ khyod 'jigs shing ya nga ba ni snang ba 'di yi dam du ma shes pas 'dre gdon du bzang bas lan pa yin na khyod kyi bskyed rim tsam po des/ ma grub zin sam du rang la thag bcad de/ yang dang khu 'phrigs se de na lus kyi gces 'dzin 'dis lan pas/ tha mal gyi zhen pa btang dgos snyam du bsam te/ rang gi mdun du mi mgo skam po gsum gyi sgyed pu gsum bsam/ sems yi dam du yod pa des rang gi thod pas phyag ste sdang pa de'i steng du bzhag /de'i nang du rang gi lus de ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bzhu ste de nas gzhi bdag des gtsor byas pa'i bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad bcu yi dam gyi lhar spyan drangs te/ de rnams la bdud rtsi de nas thod pas gcus cing drangs pas/ lha la lha thim pa'i tshul du rol bas de thams cad zag med kyi bde bas phril phril yod par bsam/ mthar bdag la mnyes cing mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par gnang bar bsams la/ lha 'dre de rnams rang la bsdu/ rang yi dam du gsal bas rang dang lha 'dre gnyis su med par/ spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la rnam rtog gis sun thag bcad de phyams lings kyi bzhag go /de'i ngang la gnyis log go /cho 'phrul byung na yi dam gyi rnam 'phrul byon pa a re dga'/ da rung de bas kyang che ba dngos grub tu byon par zhu'o snyam du bsam zhing ngag tu yang brjod la/

rig pa grung bton te/ yang dag nyid chen po'i tshogs 'khor cig bya ste/ gong gi mngon rtogs de gnad du bsnun/ mthar de thams cad rang la (285)bsdus te lha sku phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du bzhag go /mtshan mo yang de nyams su blang zhing*/ nyin par dang rang gzhan snang ba thams cad yi dam lha'i 'khor lo la yun ring du dran pa rgyun chags su bskyang zhing rang gzhan gnyis su med pa'i ngang la phyams bzhag pa'am/ bzlas pa bya'o// rgyun gtor gtong na gzhi bdag de lha'i 'khor lor byas la dbul lo// de ltar rang gi bskyed rim la bogs dbyung ba dang*/ ya nga ba'i 'khu 'phrigs nam chod chod nyams su blang*/ 'dis myur du bskyed rim brtan par byed de/ gzhan du lo gsum bsgoms pa bas/ gnyan sar zhag gsum bsgoms pa bogs che/ gzhan yang rang gi chags pa la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad sel lo// gdon lta ba yod na de'i gnod pa'i sbyor ba ldog la// lha 'dre la brten pa'i mthu dang nus pa dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*// gsum pa lam zab mo bla ma la mos gus kyis lam du byed pa ni/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi snying po bla ma'i mos gus yin/ de lam du byed pa la bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong dgos/ de la yang sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can yin/ de la sangs rgyas chos kyi sku de lus can thams cad kyi sems kyi chos nyid dang dbye ba med par bzhugs pa yin/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku de rang gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum phung khams skye mched snod bcud brtan g.yo dang dbye ba med bar bzhugs pa yin/ sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku de sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang so so skye po 'byung ba sems po thams cad kyi rang rang gi nus pas 'gro don byed pa dang dbyer med par bzhugs pa yin/ de ltar snang ba thams cad bla ma sku gsung gyi ngo bo yin/ snang ba thams cad bla mar mgo ba'am/

bla ma min pa'i 'dre gdon cig gud du byung na mos gus byas kyang ma skyes pa yin/ byin rlabs zhus kyang ma zhugs (286)pa yin/ phyogs 'dzin zhen pa'i mos zhus des don mi 'grub pa yin/ dus thams cad du rang gzhan lha 'dre bzang ngan mtho dman med par snang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du shes pas gnyis su med par gsol ba gdab bo// khyad par du lha 'dre'i bar chad dam gnod pa byung na/ rang gi mos gus la ltem brkyang byung nas/ snang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'dre gdon du bzung ba'i rnam rtog de'i rang gzugs su shes pas gnad du bsnun pa ni/ rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ 'dre gdon de rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgoms la gdan bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du spyi bo'i gtsug tu bsgom/ de la bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams bstim/ de la lus longs spyod ltos pa med bar phul la/ sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes kyis gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab/ rmad du byung ba'i byin rlabs 'byung ste/ 'dre gdon de'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi gshis bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo bor gdod ma nas dbyer med par bzhugs pa yin/ de'i gnod du de ltar bsnun pas 'dre gdon de'i gnod pa'i sbyor pa thams cad byin rlabs kyi dpung du 'bar ba ste/ gshis ci yang ma yin pas rkyen gyis cir yang byar btub pa'o// gzhan la byin rlabs byed na yang nad pa de yi dam du bsgom/ de'i spyi bor 'dre gdon de bla mar bsgoms la/ nad pa de'i lus longs spyod ltos pa med par phul la/ bla ma la bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa bstims te gsol ba btab pas/ gdon drag po la nad pa la nga ro cher 'ong bar 'dug ste/ de yang bla ma'i rnam sprul dang thugs rje'i 'dzin stangs su shes pas/ mos gus ltem brkyang med par gsol ba btab pas/ gnod byed de'i nus pa thams cad byin rlabs kyi dpung du song nas myur du nang sos nas 'gro bar 'dug ste/

nad pa'i byin rlabs kyang 'dis mdzad par gda' 'o// de ltar mos gus gnad du gtong ba 'dis rang (287)gzhan gyi rtog ngan gnod pa thams cad zlog la/ phyin chad kyang gdon gyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ myur du mos gus dang dag snang rgya chen po 'char bar 'dug go /gnyis pa rang gi mos gus la bogs dbyung zhing yang ba'i khu 'phrigs// 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa gcod pa la gsang spyod nyams su blang ba ni/ gnyan sa de gzhal yas khang*/ gzhi bdag rtsa ba'i bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo bo/ rang yi dam du gsal bas rig pa ngar dang ldan par byas te sleb pa dang bla ma yi dam zhal mjal bar bsams la/ bla ma dang mjal ba re dga' snyam du bsam la ngag tu brjod cing spros bcas drag po zhig bya'o// de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed de/ rang yi dam du bsgom/ gzhi bdag de rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgoms la/ de la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bla ma'i sku'i rnam par spyan drangs la gnyis su med par bstims pas snang ba thams cad bla mar bsgoms la/ rang gi lus dbang po khog rten dang bcas pa 'di ltos med du phul la/ lus la nye bar mkho ba'i longs spyod thams cad phul la mos gus tshad med pas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab bo// de nas byin rlabs zhus te bla ma rang la bsdus/ rang dang bla ma snang ba thams cad gnyis su med pa bla ma chos sku'i ngang la yun ring du bzhag go /de'i ngang la gnyid log go /der yang 'jigs pa dang ya nga ba'i rtog pa byung na snang ba bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yin/ lha 'dre 'di ni bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo bo yin/ khyod bla mas 'jigs sam/ bla ma dngos su byon na dga'/ zhal mjal na dga'/ gsung thos na dga'/ snang ba sku gsum gyi ngo bo la khyod 'drer 'dzin gyi rtog pa 'char ba/ mos gus kyi khams de las med pa snyam du rang la thag bcad la/ gang gi bla ma'i rnal 'byor la shin tu 'jur bar zhig gnang du gtang ngo// rmad du byung ba'i byin rlabs 'byung*/

cho 'phrul 'byung na (288)bla ma'i rnam 'phrul dang thugs rje'i 'dzin stangs su shes pa'i mos gus la drag tu bsnun pas byin rlabs kyi nyams bun ma bun ma 'ong ste/ nyams snang kha mi bskyil bar 'ur gyis gtang ngo*// de la nyin mtshan med par gsol ba rtse gcig tu 'debs shing rang lha ru krong nge*/ gzhi bdag de bla ma krong nge*/ snang ba mthong tshad bla ma sku gsum du krong krong sbyong zhing*/ rang gi mos gus la bogs thon/ ya nga ba'i snyem thag chod chod kyi bar du nyams su blang ngo*/ gtor ma la sogs pa gtong na/ yang bla ma la 'bul ba byas la btang ngo*// des rang gi mos gus la bogs rgyangs pa 'ong*/ dag snang phyogs med du 'char/ gzhi bdag de'i nus pa dang 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre thams cad kyi nus pa byin rlabs su 'char ro// gzhi bdag gnyan gin byin rlabs che bar 'ong*/ des ni byin rlabs kyi tshan ka myur du 'babs pa'o// bzhi pa gnyis med phyag rgya chen pos lam du byed pa la gnyis las/ spyir lam du slong ba ni/ smin byed dbang bzhi pa thob nas grol byed zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pa la/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus shing lus pa med par thams cad so mnyams/ mdog ma bsgyur bar rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes las mi 'da' zhing*/ de las logs pa'am/ de'i gong na gzhan med de/ spang blang med par phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor yin no// de la phyag rgya chen po min pa'i lha 'dre zhig logs su byung na/ dbang bzhi pa bskur kyang ma thob la// phyag rgya chen po bsgoms kyang ma skyes pa yin pas/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos ma lus pa thams cad rang la bsdu rang ngo shes pas/ gnyis med rang dag tu shar ba'i ngang la rgyun chad med par gnas par bya'o// khyad par du lha 'dre'i bar chad dam gnod pa byung ba'i dus su/ rang gi dge sbyor la ltem brkyang byung bas/

gang shar ngo ma shes (289)pas 'drer 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rang kha mar shor ba'i rang gzugs yin pas/ skyon gyi sa bon de ngo shes par byas la gnang du bsnun pa ni/ 'drer snang dang 'drer 'dzin bar chad gnod pa ru lam me bde nyid kyi ngo bo la bltas pas/ de'i ngo bo gsal stong blo bral yul med du rjen lhang nge 'gyur ba de/ lha 'dre ngan pa zhig gud du spangs la phyag rgya chen po bzang po zhig gud du btsal ma dgos par 'dre gdon bar chad kyi rnam rtog de nyid rang gnyis med phyag rgya chen por rang ngo shes pa de la/ bdud rang byung dang gcod rang grol zhes bya'o/ rang zhi tsa na bdud zhi/ rang gnas tsa na bdud gnas/ bdud rang du shes shings dang shes pas rgyal ba bdud las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo zhes bya'o// lha dang bcas pa'i cod pan gyi rgyan du 'gyur ro// gzhan la byin rlabs byed pa yin na/ nad pa de'i rtsar phyin pa dang*/ rang dang lha 'dre nad pa gsum rang gi sems su shes pas/ gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag pas myur du nad gdon las grol ba'i byin rlabs chen po 'byung ngo// gnyis pa rang gi rtog pa la bogs dbyung zhing ya nga ba'i khu 'phrigs gcod pa la gsang spyod bya ba ni/ rang la gdon lta ba'am gnyan sa der phyin te/ lus sems gnyis su med pa/ snang sems gnyis su med pa/ bems rig gnyis su med pa/ rang dang lha 'dre gnyan sa thams cad gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen po'i ngang la bzhag la de'i rgyun ma yengs par bskyang ngo*// ya nga ba'i khu 'phrigs sam lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung na/ 'drer 'dzin 'drer snang de nyid kyi ngo bo la ngo shes bya zhing*/ bdud rang grol dang gcod rang grol gyi gnad shes pas gang shar thams cad bzo med chos nyid du rtsal sbyang ngo*// de ltar nyams su blangs pas rang gi rtogs pa la bogs myur du thon cing*/ rang gzhan dbyer med du shes shing rnam rtog de dbang du 'dus pa'i gnad kyis gzhi bdag des gtso byas pa'i lha 'dre thams cad dbang du 'du zhing (290)phyag bya mchod pa'i gnas su 'gyur ro// de ltar lha 'dre'i gzhi gcig la rang gi byed pa tha dad kyis byed pa tha dad du 'byung ste/

gshis chos nyid ci yang ma yin pa la rkyen gyis cir yang byar btub pa'i phyir/ da phyin chad lha 'dre'i rtog pa byung tshad de ltar lam du btang zhing*/ dgra sdang ba la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan byung tshad pha ma'am/ bla ma'am/ yi dam mam/ chos skur shes pas lam du byed tshul gang yang rung bas lam du bslang ngo*// rnam rtog la bzo mkhas pa shes pas 'khor 'das kyi bde legs rang gis byed pa zhes pa yang de nyid yin la/ ltas ngan g.yang du ldog cing bar chad dngos grub tu spungs pa'ang de yin no// lha 'dre lam du byed tshul 'di mdo rgyud kyi dgongs pa thams cad dang mthun cing*/ gdams ngag bka' ma thams cad nas kyang nang gdon bla mar blta/ yi dam du blta/ chos skur blta ces pa la sogs mang du gsungs te/ nyams myong chos spyan med pas ma go /lha 'dre lam du byed pa 'di las zab pa med jo mo lab sgron ma'i bdud gcod dam/ gsang spyod zlog sgom ma la sogs pa bas kyang 'di lam gyi 'chun che ste/ 'di byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang*/ bskyed rim dang mos gus dang*/ phyag rgya chen po bzhi ka'i bogs 'don yin gsungs/ gsang spyod la gnyan sa gcig tu lha 'dre lam du byed tshul bzhi po 'di la zhag gsum gsum bcu gnyis kyis thag chod pa yin gsungs/ 'di nga'i nyams myong so ma yin pas nyams su blangs na gdams ngag gzhan dang blo bogs la khyad yod/ bsgoms la ltos gsungs/ gsang spyod rmang lam pa'i zhal gdams cung zad yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ na maḥshrī badzra yo gaṃ nī/ bla ma rin po che shrī ri ras sngon na rdo rje'i skyil krung la bzhugs pa'i dus su/ nub gcig gi nam phyed smad tsam na/ mtshan ma'i khyad par shin tu ngo mtshar che ba zhig byung*/ de nas mnal de sad pa dang*/ glu len mkha' 'gro ma bzhi bzhugs (291)nas/ hūm̐ skor gyi gdams ngag bzhi gnang ba ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gros gnang ba la 'od gsal la lam du byed pa'i hūm̐ skor dang*/

rin chen mkha' 'gros gnang ba la nad 'don gyi hūm̐ skor dang*/ padma mkha' 'gros gnang ba la thig le dbang du byed pa'i hūm̐ skor dang*/ las kyi mkha' 'gros gnang ba la bar chad sel ba'i hūm̐ skor dang bzhi gnang ba yin/ de rnams las mjal lugs dang gnas lugs brdar bstan pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar che ba yod de smra ma btub gsungs/ de la rin chen mkha' 'gros gnang ba nad 'don gyi hūm̐ skor ni/ rin chen mkha' 'gro sku mdog mi sha kha ser mo sku la rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thugs kha na hūm̐ mthing ka bzhugs pa/ de las hūm̐ dkar po chad cing gyen la 'phro ba/ dmar po chad cing thur du 'phro ba/ phyag zhabs hūm̐ mthing ga rgyun pa ru 'byung zhing rgyun pa ru 'phro ba/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thugs ka nas shangs sdo'i bar du hūm̐ mthing kha breng chags su byung zhing*/ shangs sgo nas hūm̐ gcig chad de rang gi khar thim pa dang*/ nga'i snying khar 'tshangs pa 'dra ba'i mi bde ba gcig yod pa de/ rang dbang med par drangs zhing 'gro ba'i rnam 'phrul de lta bu gcig bstan nas de nas 'di skad gsungs te/ hūm̐ las hūm̐ 'phros hūm̐ gis sbyong*// hūm̐ bsgom hūm̐ gi 'phro 'du yis// rang gzhan nad rnams hūm̐ gis 'joms// ces gsungs te/ gsung gi tshig de dang gong gi brda' de la brten nas nad 'don gyi go ba 'di snyed pa yin gsung ngo// 'di la gnyis/ rang gi nad 'don pa dang*/ gzhan gyi nad 'don pa'o// dang po ni lus yi dam du gsal ba/ 'khrul 'khor skyil krung drang por 'dug la/ snying ga'i dkyil du hūm̐ mthing ga rtse ser gcig tshad tsam shin tu gsal bar bsgom/ de nas nad tsha grang gnyis brtags la tshad pa'i nad kyi sde tshan yin na thugs ka'i hūm̐ mthing ga de las hūm̐ dkar po nas gang ba gcig chad de/ lus kyi stod smad (292)thams cad khor bskor bas nad gdon thams cad khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa'am/
