nor bu sbur len gyis spur sdus pa bzhin 'ub ril gyis bsdus te/ spyi gtsug nas rgyangs thon/ nam mkha'i dkyil shin tu mtho bar yal gyis yal bar bsgom zhing*/ hūm̐ gis gdangs dang ldan pa'i rlung drag po gyen la 'bud do/ grang ba'i nad kyi sde tshan yin na/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ dmar po drod kyi rang bzhin can gcig chad nas lus kyi smad du bskor bas/ nad thams cad bsdus nas 'og sgo nas 'thon te sa'i steng shin tu dma' bar yal bar bsam mo// nad ngos ma zin na thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ mthing ga gcig chad de/ lus kyi stod smad thams cad du bskor nas na ba thams cad bsdus nas rlung gang rgyu ba'i sna sgo nas 'thon te mdun gyi bar snang la yal bar bsam/ yan lag gi nad skrangs pa la sogs pa thams cad la khol bu'i nad la/ gang na ba'i sar hūm̐ mthing ga nas gang ba gcig bsam ste/ nad thams cad lhag ma med par de la bsdus nas skrangs pa'i dmigs sam/ sor mo'i rtse mo nas 'thon te/ nam mkha' la yal bar bsam mo// nad 'don de rnams byin rlabs so ma yin pas shin tu rno zhing zab par 'dug go /rnam rtog gis bar ma chad par bsgom na nad che chung med par gang yang 'thon par 'dug go ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan gyi nad 'don pa ni/ nad pa de'i drung du sleb pa dang byang chub kyi sems la dungs pa gcig gnad du btang la/ lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos 'dug ste/ rang gi rlung g.yas g.yon gang rgyu ba'i phyogs su nad pa bzhag la/ nad pa de'i yang rlung gang rgyu'i phyogs ston du gzhug /de gnyis ka 'dzom na rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin/ mos gus drag po bsgom du gzhug /rang gi thugs gar hūm̐ mthing kha de gsal bar bsgom/ de nas rlung gcig drag tu shad bus la thugs ka'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ rgyun par chad de/ rlung gang rgyu ba'i sna sgo nas thugs ka'i bar gyi rtsa'i nang du hūm̐ gis khrigs (293)gang ste/

sna sgo nas hūm̐ gcig lhug se yod par bsam/ yang nad pa de'i phyogs su rlung gcig drag tu bus pas/ sna sgo'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig chad de/ nad pa'i nad tshad pa yin na stod/ grang ba yin na smad/ gang du gang na ba'i sar hūm̐ de phar song bas/ nad thams cad rang dbang med par hūm̐ de la 'ub ril gyis bsdus nas/ yang rlung tshur la drag tu rngubs pas/ hūm̐ dang nad du bcas pa rang dbang med par tshur rngubs te/ sna sgo'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang drag tu bus pas hūm̐ de phar song nas nad thams cad bsdus/ yang rngubs pas sna sgo'i hūm̐ la thim ste/ de lta bu lan bdun gyi bar du byas nas de nas phyi phyogs su shad bus pas/ sna'i nang gi hūm̐ thams cad gcig gis gcig ded de/ phyir nyel spyi bo nas/ hūm̐ mtha' ma des sna bkag par bsam ste rang srung ba yin/ nad 'don shin tu rno ba tsher ma 'don pa 'dra ba 'ong bar 'dug ste/ gang rung rung la byas na rang la gzan par 'dug /dam sel lam/ sdig sgrib bam 'chal ba'i skyon yod pa la byas na rnal 'byor pa'i tshe la bar byung dogs yod pas/ slob ma mos/

nad pa'i yang sna gong gnyis snying ga dang gsum du hūm̐ na thing ga re bsgoms te rang srung ba yin mchan/ lus can nam/ grogs dam tshig can nam/ nye du snying reg ma yin pa la bya ru mi btub gsungs/ spyan snga nas phyag len 'di ka mdzad par 'dug ste/ nad de tog len pa 'dra ba 'ong gin 'dug /nad 'don hūm̐ chos ma'i zhal gdams*/ ༈ na maḥshrī badzra yo gi nī/ 'dzag srung bka' rgya ma la gsum/ dmigs pa bka' rgya ma/ 'khrul 'khor bka' rgya ma/ rdzas srung bka' rgya ma/ dang po ni spyir thabs lam sgom pa na 'dzag pa'i gegs 'di ka 'ong bar 'dug /de sel yang dka'/ phal che rang la gegs su 'ong ba mang bar 'dug /dmigs pa dang 'khrul 'khor legs legs 'dra ba/ nyan tsa na rna bar snyan pa de rnams la sgom tsa na g.yud mi 'dug (294)gsungs/ gdams ngag gnad du song na/ byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra ba rtseg tsam la/ nyan tsa na yid mi ches pa 'dra ba zhig gis bsgom tsa na gnad du song 'ong ba yin/ lar kha tsho che ba mang ste gdams pa 'di 'dra gzhan na mi bdog go /gnad zab mo 'di rnams sla mo gcig yod pas shin tu gsang bar bya gsungs nas bka' rgya dam bo mdzad par gda'a'o// de la dmigs pa dang po ni/ yang dgon na 'dag char mdzad pa'i dus su nangs phyogs shig bde ba zug rngu dang bcas pa drag po gcig skyes nas/ thig le 'chor la khang pa zhig byung bas/ bla ma la gsol ba btab pas/ tshig 'di gnyis nam mkha' la lhang byung ste/ zla ba mthur du 'dzag pa na/ haṃ yig gyin la bzhengs par bya/ ces bya ba la dmigs pa de'i yan lag tu rdo rje'i bu gar phaṭa dmar ser mgo thur la bstan pa gcig bsam/ rdo rje'i rtse mo nas lte ba'i bar rtsa'i nang*/ hūm̐ dkar po mgo gyen la bstan pa breng chags su yod par bsam/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du hūm̐ phyed phyed phyir thon/ phyed phyed nang du nub pas 'bag zhal du yod par bsam/ de nas haṃ yig gyen la bzhengs par bya ba la shes ba drag tu gtad cing*/

rlung gyen la shad shad pa drag tu bud/ rjes la phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag /dmigs pa gnyis pas gsang khrig kyi dmigs pa yin/ rdo rje'i rtse mo nas yar phyir ldog tu 'bu ru ru byung ste/ spyi bo nas tur thon nas mtho gang tsam du phyu re yod pa la rig pa drag tu gtad/ dmigs pa 'di gnyis ngag 'dren pa zhi drag phal bas 'chun che bar 'dug /'dzag pa drug ka srung bar 'dug ste/ rmi lam du 'dzag na gnyid log khar mang du bsgom/ bde ba skyes pa la sogs pa nam 'dzag pa'i dus su bsgom/ thun zhabs thams cad la bsgom mo// gnyis pa 'khrul 'khor bka' rgya ma ni/ gyad gyi 'dug stangs bgrad pa'i mtha' des byang sems 'bab pa'i rtsa sum cu so gnyis (295)kyi rtsa kha 'thems pa yin/ lan gnyis lan gsum gyis gzer thems bkag pa bzhin 'gro bar 'dug ste/ 'dzag pa'i dus ma yin par byas na bde nyams la gnod gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ shing bu mtho gang ba gcig gis rked pa na tha gus btags nas/ shing bu ar bu ta'i gnas su drang por bzhag ste/ lam pa ka'i gnas su tha gus btod nas mi 'chug par byas pas/ rtsa g.yon pa'i kha 'thems nas ma 'jag pa yin/ gdams ngag khol du bton na byis pa'i rtsed mo 'dra/ gsum pa rdzas srung bka' rgya ma ni/ de thams cad kyi sa ma phan na/ gshin rje'i ral pa bslad med gcig drag po'i thun rdzas rgyal po gcig /padma rakta rom/ grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa gcig /na ra ma go ti rul ngas su ma song ba gcig /ma hā bhu lu/ rgya'i tshil bu/ de rnams cha snyoms pa zhib tu btags la/ byis pa lo brgyad pa nad med kyi dri chus sbrus la/ ril bu yungs dkar gyi 'bru tsam grib skam byas la/ nang nub bzhin rdo rje'i bu gar re re bcug pas gzer thems khegs pa bzhin 'gyur ro// 'di thabs gzhan gyis ma phan nas rtsa kha bye nas chu bzhin 'dzag pa yang 'phral du khrig gis 'gro bar 'gyur ro// zla ba phyed kyi bar du bsten na lo gcig tsam gyi bar du srung ba yin gsungs/

'dzag srung bka' rgya ma'i zhal gdams che long tsam yi ger bkod pa'o// ri chos lam gyi khog chen la// ma drug don snying mi bdog na// gnad chen mang yang ma tshang bas// 'chug med lag len shes pa dka'// bla ma brten yun thung ba yis// zab mo'i rtsa ba mi chod pas// gdams ngag thob lo mi byed par// zhabs pad gtsug tu bsten byos la// zab mo gsung gi bdud rtsi de// yid tshims lhag ma ming 'thungs na// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par nges// dben gnas bu la'i gangs (296)'dabs su// bla ma dam pa'i gsung sgros la// dbri bsnan lhag chad med pa 'di// gsol btab dgyes bzhin gnang ba yin// blo dman bsgom pa rin ldan gyis// rang nyid mi brjed gzungs su bris/ /dge des gdams ngag bdud rtsi 'di/ /dri med phyogs bcur gsal gyur nas// chos rje'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par shog //
